title: AI Enabled QA Automation Lead
description:
**Back to jobs**

AI Enabled QA Automation Lead

**Location: Pune, India**

We are looking for a AI Enabled Quality Automation Lead to drive end-to-end testing strategy, build scalable automation frameworks, and lead QA teams responsible for delivering reliable software products.

This role is designed for an experienced quality automation professional with strong foundations in automation architecture, software testing practices, coding, and agile product delivery.

You will work closely with engineering teams, product teams, and customer stakeholders to integrate quality across the complete software development lifecycle. The role requires technical depth, hands-on automation experience, and the ability to guide teams in solving complex quality challenges.

At Indexnine, we are building an AI-first engineering culture where quality engineering goes beyond traditional testing. You will use AI tools, automation, and engineering practices to accelerate test creation, improve coverage, analyze software quality, and validate modern AI-enabled applications.

**Responsibilities:**

**Quality Engineering & Test Strategy**

* Define testing strategy, scope, quality standards, and risk-based testing approaches aligned with product objectives.
* Establish strong quality practices across all phases of the software development lifecycle.
* Lead functional testing, integration testing, regression testing, and release validation activities.
* Maintain test documentation, quality metrics, execution reports, and defect analysis insights.
* Monitor engineering quality indicators including defect leakage, automation coverage, regression coverage, and release readiness.
* Establish quality gates and continuous improvement practices to improve software reliability.

**Test Automation**

* Design and build scalable automation frameworks aligned with application architecture and engineering practices.
* Develop and maintain automation suites integrated with CI/CD workflows.
* Review automation code and establish engineering standards for test development.
* Improve automation coverage across UI, API, functional, and regression testing layers.
* Build reusable automation components, testing utilities, and quality accelerators.

**Product & Engineering Collaboration**

* Participate in requirement analysis, architecture discussions, and design reviews to identify quality considerations early.
* Collaborate with product teams during MVP planning, backlog prioritization, and roadmap discussions.
* Work with engineering teams to improve testability, maintainability, and overall product quality.
* Identify opportunities to improve engineering efficiency through automation and AI-enabled solutions.

**Agile Delivery & Project Leadership**

* Convert product requirements into clear test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and validation plans.
* Lead testing activities across sprint planning, backlog refinement, execution, and releases.
* Track delivery progress, identify risks early, and communicate quality status to stakeholders.
* Monitor sprint health, defect trends, testing effectiveness, and release quality metrics.

**Team Leadership & Mentorship**

* Lead QA teams with ownership across planning, execution, and delivery outcomes.
* Mentor engineers on automation practices, test design, debugging approaches, and engineering fundamentals.
* Build a team culture focused on accountability, technical growth, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**AI-Enabled Testing & Engineering**

* Apply AI tools to accelerate test design, automation development, defect analysis, and engineering productivity.
* Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted testing platforms and developer productivity tools.
* Build scripts, workflows, and AI agents to improve testing efficiency and coverage.
* Analyze code quality reports using tools such as SonarQube and drive quality improvements.
* Define validation approaches for AI-enabled systems and review AI-generated code outputs.

**Qualification:**

* 7+ years of experience in software testing, automation, and quality engineering.
* Strong experience defining test strategies and leading quality initiatives for software products.
* Hands-on expertise in designing automation frameworks integrated with CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong programming skills using languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or similar technologies.
* Solid understanding of computer science fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, and system design concepts.
* Experience with test management and defect tracking platforms such as Jira, Zephyr, TestRail, or Azure DevOps.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery practices and sprint-based execution.
* Experience leading QA teams and collaborating with product, engineering, and customer stakeholders.
* Ability to measure and improve quality using metrics such as defect leakage, automation coverage, and regression coverage.
* Exposure to AI-assisted development, testing platforms, or code quality analysis tools.

**Preferred Technology Stack:**

**Automation & Testing**

* Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, Rest Assured

**Programming Languages**

* Python, Robot Framework, JavaScript, TypeScript

**API Testing**

* Postman, REST Assured, SOAP UI

**CI/CD & DevOps**

* Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps

**Test Management**

* Jira, Zephyr, TestRail, Azure DevOps

**Performance Engineering**

* JMeter, LoadRunner

**Code Quality & Security**

* SonarQube, Checkmarx

**Cloud & Infrastructure**

* AWS, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes

**Version Control**

* Git, Bitbucket

**AI Engineering Tools**

* + GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, AI-assisted testing platforms, and modern AI productivity tools

title: Associate Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
Why it’s worth it:
  
  
ReliaQuest’s Quality Engineering team is evolving quality from a test-execution function into a platform capability focused on automation, reliability, and production safety. As an Associate Software Development Engineer in Test, you will help build automated testing and continuous integration capabilities across backend services, web applications, and mobile platforms.
  
  
This is a code-first, automation-focused engineering role—not a manual testing or documentation-only position. You will gain hands-on experience with production-level systems, test automation, CI/CD, failure analysis, and AI-assisted engineering practices. Training, pairing, and guidance will be provided, with attitude and aptitude valued over previous job titles.
  
  
The everyday hustle:
  
  

* Build and maintain automated API smoke and regression tests for backend services.
* Contribute to UI automation using Playwright and, based on interest and business needs, mobile automation.
* Improve test reliability, test data setup, and environment stability.
* Develop and maintain automated tests that run within GitLab CI pipelines.
* Investigate flaky or failing pipelines and, with guidance, determine whether failures are caused by product defects, test code, or environmental issues.
* Analyze logs, metrics, and test reports to identify and troubleshoot failures across services and environments.
* Create clear, actionable bug reports that include reproduction steps and relevant technical details.
* Collaborate with Software Engineering, SRE, and DevOps teams to resolve quality and reliability issues.
* Contribute to test standards, automation frameworks, pre-commit hooks, engineering helpers, and other quality tooling.
* Help shape how quality is consistently measured and enforced across services.
* Use Claude and other AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate test discovery, automation design, code review, failure triage, and technical documentation.
* Identify repeatable Quality Engineering tasks where AI can improve speed, consistency, and effectiveness.
* Carefully validate and refine AI-generated outputs to ensure they meet engineering, reliability, and security expectations.
* Share useful AI prompts, patterns, and workflows with the broader QA/SDET team.
* Continuously improve automation and quality practices to help prevent incidents rather than only identify defects after they occur.

Do you have what it takes?
  
  

* Foundational experience reading and modifying code in Java, TypeScript, or a similar programming language.
* Basic knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP methods, and HTTP status codes.
* Familiarity with Git and branch-based development workflows.
* A willingness to debug issues across multiple layers, including test code, services, pipelines, and environments.
* An automation-first mindset and an interest in building reliable, maintainable test solutions.
* Working knowledge of Claude or similar AI-assisted engineering tools and an understanding of how they can support test design, automation, debugging, failure analysis, and productivity.
* The judgment to validate, refine, and correct AI-generated recommendations rather than accepting them without review.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly when documenting defects and collaborating with technical teams.
* A collaborative mindset and eagerness to learn through training, pairing, and feedback.

What makes you uncommon?
  
  

* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines or automated quality gates.
* Experience with test automation frameworks or API testing tools.
* Familiarity with Playwright, Selenium, or mobile automation technologies.
* Experience reviewing logs, dashboards, metrics, or monitoring tools.
* Exposure to production or staging incidents and root-cause investigation.
* Experience using AI tools to generate or improve automation scripts, test cases, API scenarios, or debugging workflows.
* Familiarity with prompt-writing techniques for technical work such as log analysis, code explanation, test coverage review, and root-cause analysis.
* An interest in improving shared automation platforms, developer tooling, and organization-wide Quality Engineering practices.

title: Advanced Project Engr - Teamcenter and Polarian
description:

You will report directly to our Program Manager, and you’ll work out of our India location on a Hybrid work schedule.
  
  
In this role, you will impact on the organization by ensuring that our Teamcenter and Polarion systems are optimized for performance and usability, thereby enhancing the overall productivity of our teams. Your expertise will help in driving continuous improvement initiatives and ensuring compliance with industry standards.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

Evaluate Functional Requirements: Analyze and document functional requirements for Teamcenter and Polarion, ensuring they align with business objectives. Collaborate with stakeholders to gather input and clarify requirements, facilitating a comprehensive understanding of needs.
  
  
Impact Assessment: Assess the impact of proposed changes on existing processes and systems. Conduct thorough analysis to identify potential risks and benefits, providing recommendations to stakeholders to aid in decision-making.
  
  
Testing Management: Develop and execute detailed testing plans for Teamcenter and Polarion functionalities. This includes creating test cases, executing tests, and documenting results to ensure that all updates meet quality standards and specifications.
  
  
Deployment Coordination: Oversee the deployment of updates and enhancements to Teamcenter and Polarion. Work closely with IT and other relevant departments to ensure that deployments are executed smoothly and that any issues are promptly addressed.

Facilitate communication and alignment among teams to support cohesive operations.
  
  
Monitoring and Reporting: Monitor access changes and system performance, ensuring compliance with security protocols and best practices. Prepare regular reports on system performance, testing outcomes, and user feedback, providing insights for continuous improvement.
  
  
Risk Mitigation: Identify potential risks associated with changes and deployments, developing strategies to mitigate these risks. Ensure that all changes are implemented with minimal disruption to operations and that contingency plans are in place.
  
  
MAJOR KPIs
  
  
Access Change: Track and manage access changes to ensure that all users have the appropriate permissions while maintaining system security.
  
  
Impact Assessment: Evaluate the impact of functional changes on existing systems and processes, providing detailed reports to stakeholders.
  
  
Implementation Success: Drive the successful implementation of changes and enhancements, ensuring they are completed within agreed timelines and with minimal disruption.
  
  
Testing Efficiency: Ensure that all testing activities are conducted as per Service Level Agreements (SLA), maintaining high standards of quality and performance.
  
  
User Training Effectiveness: Measure the effectiveness of user training sessions through feedback and performance metrics, ensuring users are confident in utilizing the systems.
  
  
**Benefits Of Working For Honeywell India**
Comprehensive health insurance coverage for employees and their families.
  
  
Generous paid time off policy, including vacation and sick leave.
  
  
Performance-based bonuses and incentives.
  
  
Retirement savings plan with employer matching.
  
  
Access to professional development programs and training opportunities.
  
  
Employee wellness programs and mental health support.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Extensive Experience: A minimum of 8 years of hands-on experience in Teamcenter and Polarion, demonstrating a deep understanding of their functionalities and applications in a business context.
  
  
Functional Requirement Evaluation: Proven ability to evaluate functional requirements and manage change impacts effectively, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
  
  
Testing Methodologies: Strong experience in testing methodologies, including the development, execution, and documentation of test scripts to validate system functionalities.
  
  
Deployment Processes: Familiarity with deployment processes and best practices, ensuring smooth transitions and minimal disruption during updates.
  
  
Training and Support Skills: Ability to develop training materials and conduct training sessions for end-users, ensuring they are equipped to utilize Teamcenter and Polarion effectively.
  
  
Collaboration Skills: Excellent interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
  
  
WE VALUE
  
  
Educational Background: A bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred, with a strong foundation in technical concepts.
  
  
Industry Experience: 5+ years of experience in a similar role, preferably within a multinational corporation, with a focus on product lifecycle management.
  
  
Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on continuous improvement and the ability to assess complex situations effectively.
  
  
Project Management: Experience in project management, with the ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while meeting deadlines.
  
  
Adaptability: A proactive and adaptable mindset, with the ability to thrive in a dynamic work environment and embrace change.
  
  
**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Global Quality Sr. System Engineer
description:
****POSITION SUMMARY****
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Global QMS System Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting digital Quality Management System (QMS) applications using Microsoft Power Platform and related technologies. This role focuses on building scalable, user-centric solutions that enable global quality processes including problem solving (8D), audits, CAPA, supplier quality, and read across.
  
  
The engineer works closely with Quality, Operations, and IT teams to translate business requirements into robust digital tools, ensuring data integrity, process standardization, and real-time visibility across global manufacturing sites. This role plays a critical part in advancing Vertiv’s Quality Excellence framework and enabling closed-loop, data-driven decision making.
  
  
****RESPONSIBILITIES****

* Design, develop, and maintain PowerApps applications supporting QMS processes (CAPA, 8D, audits, supplier quality, complaints, read across)
* Build and manage integrations between PowerApps, SharePoint, Power Automate, and external systems (ERP, data lake, reporting tools)

title: Robotics Intern
description:
All roles ROS 2PythonHardware Robotics Intern

Pune, IndiaInternship

Apply

We are looking for a hands-on Robotics Intern who wants to learn how real robot systems are built, integrated, and tested, working alongside our senior engineers on live robotics and automation programs.

This internship is suited for a student or early-career engineer who has built small robotics projects, is comfortable writing code on Linux, and wants to see their work run on real or simulated robots rather than stay on slides.

**What you'll work on**

* ROS 2 nodes, launch files, and configuration for robot software stacks.
* Integrating sensors such as cameras, LiDARs, IMUs, and encoders, and checking their data.
* Writing Python or C++ utilities, test scripts, and small tools for the engineering team.
* Running tests on real robots and in simulation, and recording what worked and what failed.
* Robot bring-up support: wiring checks, calibration steps, and parameter tuning under guidance.
* Logging, rosbag recording, data visualisation, and basic debugging of robot behaviour.
* Documentation of setups, procedures, and test results.

You will work closely with senior engineers, take ownership of well-defined tasks, reproduce issues, and report clear findings that help the team move forward.

**What we're looking for**

* Working knowledge of Python or C++.
* Comfort with Linux, the terminal, and Git.
* Basic understanding of ROS or ROS 2 concepts such as nodes, topics, services, and TF.
* Familiarity with coordinate frames and basic robot kinematics at a coursework level.
* At least one robotics, embedded, or automation project you can explain in detail.
* Willingness to work on hardware, follow test procedures, and debug patiently.
* Clear written communication when reporting progress and issues.

**Good to have**

* Robot software: ROS 2, MoveIt 2, Nav2, RViz.
* Simulation: Gazebo, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Webots.
* Hardware and embedded: Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi, Jetson, serial / CAN interfaces.
* Perception basics: OpenCV, depth cameras, AprilTag / ArUco markers.

Participation in robotics competitions, student robotics teams, or open-source robotics projects is an added advantage.

**Who will fit this role**

You should be comfortable picking up a defined task, learning the tools it needs, testing it on a robot, and reporting honestly on the result, including what did not work.

We are looking for someone who learns quickly, is not afraid of hardware, and wants to grow into an engineer who can bring a robot system up end to end.

This is an internship position.

**If this is your seat**

Send the application. We read every one, and we write back when it's a fit.

Apply

Visual Basic 6 (VB6), C#, .NET Framework, .NET 8+, ASP.NET Core, .NET MAUI, WinUI, WPF, XAML, HTML5, JavaScript

Synon (CA 2E), RPG, RPGLE, CLP, IBM i / AS400, DB2, SQL Server, Stored Procedures, API Development

Azure OpenAI
**,**

title: Associate Director, Software Engineering
description:
Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering

Principal responsibilities

The Performance Testing Engineer will be responsible for defining and executing performance testing for HSBC Open Banking Cloud solutions, ensuring services meet non-functional requirements for scalability, resilience and stability. The role will work closely with engineering, SRE/DevOps, and product teams to identify bottlenecks early, drive performance improvements, and embed performance testing into CI/CD pipelines.

* Define performance testing strategy, approach and success criteria aligned to Open Banking non-functional requirements (throughput, latency, error rates, capacity and scalability).
* Design, build and maintain automated performance test suites (load, stress, endurance/soak, spike), integrating execution into CI/CD pipelines.
* Create realistic workload models using production-like usage patterns, including API-level test scenarios and data design suitable for performance testing.
* Analyse results (response times, resource utilisation, thread/connection behaviour, queueing), identify bottlenecks and provide actionable recommendations to development and platform teams.
* Collaborate with SRE/DevOps to set up performance environments, monitoring, dashboards and alerts using tooling such as Splunk, AppDynamics and CloudWatch.
* Validate performance of cloud-native components (for example API Gateway, AWS Lambda, Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), load balancers, databases) and support tuning activities.
* Produce clear performance reports and communicate risks, remediation plans and trends to stakeholders; promote performance engineering best practices across the team.
* Support releases by providing performance sign-off evidence and contribute to incident triage where performance degradation is suspected.

Requirements

* Minimum Bachelor Degree of Engineering with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong hands-on experience in performance testing and performance engineering for APIs and distributed systems.
* Proven experience with performance test tools such as JMeter and/or Gatling (or equivalent), including scripting, parameterisation, correlation and result analysis.
* Experience implementing performance testing in CI/CD (for example Jenkins) and using version control and collaboration tooling (Jira, GitHub, Confluence).
* Good understanding of AWS and cloud-native architectures, including performance characteristics of networking, load balancing, auto-scaling and container platforms.
* Strong skills in monitoring/observability and performance diagnostics using tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics and CloudWatch; ability to interpret metrics, logs and traces.
* Working knowledge of Linux and scripting (Python and/or Shell) to automate test execution, environment checks and reporting.
* Strong understanding of non-functional requirements, resilience patterns and high availability concepts; ability to translate requirements into measurable test outcomes.
* Good to have banking domain knowledge and familiarity with Open Banking/API ecosystems.

**Technology Consulting**
**Title: Application Engineer - III**
EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
  
  
Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology**
supports our technology needs through three business units:
  
  
**Client Technology (CT) -**
focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
  
  
**Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) –**
EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
  
  
**Information Security (Info Sec) -**
Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
  
  
**The opportunity**
This role provides advanced-level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases under general direction, and leads front-end and back-end technologies, ensuring the functionality and user experience of the web solutions. The role requires a very strong understanding of front-end frameworks and back-end logic integration, optimization, data integration, documentation, and secure, scalable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.

* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.
* Elevates code into the development, test, and production environments on schedule. Provides follow up production support. Submits change control requests and documents.
* Thoroughly understands software development methodology. Thoroughly understands development architecture standards. Trains and mentors staff with less experience. Resolves elevated issues.
* Participates in design, code, and test inspections throughout the life cycle to identify issues. Explains technical considerations at related meetings, including those with internal clients. Performs systems analysis activities.
* Thoroughly understands client business functions and technology needs. Has a broad understanding of Vanguard's technologies, tools, and applications, including those that interface with business area and systems.
* Interfaces with cross functional team members, and communicates systems issues at the appropriate technical level for each audience.
* Thoroughly understands and complies with Information Technology and Information Security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders
* Must Have skills: AWS Frontend leaning Full stack development with Java, Spring boot Microservices, API Integrations experience required.
* Typescript, React JS

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, system integration, database design, and back-end architecture.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.
* Expertise in server-side development, system integration, and API management; strong knowledge of database design, optimization, debugging, and performance tuning.
* Must-have skills: Angular (V18 & above), Angular Material, Angular JS, Typescript, React JS, Java, Spring Boot, Node JS, AWS, CloudFormation, ECS, Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, IAM, SQL queries, GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, CI/CD, TDD/BDD, Splunk, Honeycomb, Python.
* Knowledge of Agile, Confluence, JIRA; aptitude for continuous process improvement for process flows/workflows.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.
* Experience with AWS EC2 for compute provisioning and management.
* Experience with AWS SQS for queue-based messaging and asynchronous processing.
* Demonstrates proficiency in JavaScript.
* Possesses hands-on experience working with GitHub Actions.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)

**What We Look For**

* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.

**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**About Smart Working**

  
  

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

  
  

**About the Role**

  

As a QA Automation Engineer, you will take end-to-end ownership of quality across a large, roughly 10-year, multi-repo digital health platform. You will build the automated test framework hands-on, define expected behaviour, and help improve reliability from an existing baseline where test coverage and pass rates need strengthening.

  

You will work with an engineering team of 4, collaborating to understand how the system should work from client, end-user and internal operations perspectives. The role is predominantly hands-on and independent, with shared responsibility for product quality.

  

The first phase will involve speaking with stakeholders, clarifying requirements, documenting expected behaviour, and building out automation that enables faster, safer releases.

**Responsibilities**
  

  
* Own the quality process end to end and build the automated test framework hands-on
  
* Understand how a large, roughly 10-year, multi-repo system works and how it should work from client, end-user and internal operations perspectives
  
* Ask the right questions and document expected behaviour where inherited documentation is partly out of date
  
* Author English-readable scenarios in Cucumber and Gherkin
  
* Build automation in JavaScript and TypeScript
  
* Drive the UI through a page object model
  
* Add data-test-ids to React code where missing
  
* Validate correct database state using SQL
  
* Maintain the automated tests as new features arrive
  
* Feed into requirements upfront as new features are planned
  
* Flag compliance, regulatory and security implications
  
* Run exploratory testing to identify where the product behaves incorrectly
  
* Improve reliability and enable faster, safer releases through automation
  
* Reproduce multi-step defects precisely and identify edge cases
  
* Build a repeatable, documented QA process from an unreliable baseline
  
* Work out how the system should behave across multiple user perspectives and how it might break
  
  

  
**Requirements**
  

  
* 4+ years of experience in QA or test automation, hands-on with TypeScript or JavaScript
  
* 4+ years of hands-on test automation coding in TypeScript or JavaScript
  
* 2+ years of BDD test authoring with Cucumber and Gherkin
  
* 3+ years of web UI test automation using a page object model, preferably with Playwright
  
* 2+ years of end-to-end QA ownership, including defining, documenting, building and maintaining tests
  
* 3+ years of requirements analysis and stakeholder communication
  
* 2+ years of SQL querying to validate database state, using MySQL or PostgreSQL
  
* 3+ years of exploratory testing and precise multi-step defect reproduction
  
* Ability to drive automation and own the build with limited direction
  
* Strong detail orientation, including the ability to spot edge cases and gaps in specifications
  
* Hands-on JavaScript or TypeScript automation coding is non-negotiable; willingness to learn is not sufficient
  
  

  
**Nice to Have**
  

  
* Mobile app testing and automation experience, especially with Flutter apps
  
* Experience with Appium or Flutter integration\_test
  
* Experience reading and working with React front-end code
  
* Experience with Angular, Vue or another modern JavaScript framework
  
* Security and regulatory awareness, including ISO 27001, GDPR or NHS DTAC
  
* Experience in another regulated or audited environment
  
* ISO 13485 medical-device regulated-environment testing
  
* Experience in an adjacent regulated domain such as medtech, fintech or NHS/DTAC
  
* Healthtech or digital health domain experience
  
* Comfort using AI in the engineering workflow
  
  

  
**Benefits**

Someone who will be a foundational member of our Systems team and help build the technology infrastructure that powers everything we do. This is not an advisory role. We need someone who designs solutions, builds them, integrates them, and owns them end-to-end. The right candidate is a Salesforce expert and multi-system integrator who understands how enterprise systems connect, owns integration architecture across the full technology environment (not just Salesforce), and actively uses Claude and Claude Code to drive automation across the SDLC. If you want to build something meaningful from the ground up, establishing an in-house platform engineering capability at a firm where technology is becoming a true differentiator. This is that opportunity.

**Responsibilities Platform Architecture & Salesforce Ownership**

● Own end-to-end solution design and execution for the Salesforce platform, including data models, integration architecture, automation patterns, configuration, custom code, deployment, and maintenance.

● Make independent architectural decisions within established guardrails; collaborate with the internal architect on complex or cross-system decisions.

● Develop and maintain Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, LWC, SOQL, and SFDX-based deployments.

● Own integration architecture and technical guidance across the full technology ecosystem, not limited to Salesforce. When any systems need to connect, this role defines how.

● Lead the technical configuration and integration of new systems brought into the environment, including those that interact with Salesforce and those that do not.

● Define and enforce technical standards, patterns, and best practices for the platform.

**AI-Assisted Development & Automation**

● Use Claude, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, and Agentforce as primary development instruments — automation-first engineering throughout the full SDLC.

● Follow a systematic AI development workflow: AI-assisted code generation → rigorous review and validation → automated testing → controlled CI/CD deployment. Never AI-generated code straight to production.

● Build AI-driven workflows to eliminate manual tasks and measurably increase throughput across requirements, design, build, test, and release.

● Set and model the standard for responsible, systematic AI-assisted development across the team.

**Change Control & DevOps**

● Own Git-based change control (GitHub, Bitbucket, or equivalent): branching, PR governance, code review standards, and release management for all Salesforce development.

● Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with automated testing and deployment validation before changes reach production.

● Ensure all changes (configuration, code, and integrations) are version-controlled, traceable, and auditable.

**Technical Leadership, Agile & Stakeholder Partnership**

● Serve as technical lead for QA testers and developers; manage the Systems Project Board and sprint flow.

● Partner with the internal architect for guidance and provide technical oversight for external developers as the team scales.

● Translate business requirements into sprint-ready technical solutions in partnership with the Product Manager.

● Must be available for U.S. stakeholder meetings during evening hours (IST), typically 6:00-9:00 PM IST, to maintain overlapping business hours with the U.S. team. Communicate status, risks, and dependencies proactively.

● Own the debugging and case board; scale into team management as QA and development resources grow.

**Candidate Profile**

● 5+ years hands-on Salesforce experience — configuration AND development (Apex, LWC, SOQL, APIs, administration)

● 1+ year using AI coding tools (Claude / Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) with a systematic workflow: AI development → code review → automated testing → controlled deployment

● Architect-level solution design — data modeling, integration architecture, platform standards

● Broad system integration experience — REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, middleware, databases (SQL/NoSQL), and third-party platforms. Comfortable architecting integrations between any combination of systems, not limited to Salesforce Tools & Platforms.

● Git-based version control (GitHub, Bitbucket, or equivalent): branching, PR governance, Salesforce CI/CD

● Experience directing or guiding QA testers and/or developers on technical deliverables

● Active Agile participation — sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives

● Salesforce certifications (Admin, Platform Developer I or II, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud)

● Salesforce Architect certification (Application Architect, System Architect, or CTA) — a plus, not required

● Familiarity with JavaScript and Google Apps Script for Google Workspace integrations Candidates should be comfortable working across the following:

● Salesforce — Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, custom objects and integrations

● Claude & Claude Code — primary AI development environment (enterprise license)

● Git-based version control — GitHub / Bitbucket, CI/CD pipelines, SFDX, Gearset or equivalent

● Google Workspace — Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Apps Script integrations

● Project management — Jira | Additional AI tooling — Codex, GitHub Copilot, Agentforce

* Design, develop, execute, and maintain robust automated test frameworks and regression packs.
* Create and maintain automation scripts for functional, integration, API, end-to-end, and regression testing.
* Ensure automation solutions are scalable, reusable, and aligned with engineering standards.
* Continuously improve automation coverage and reduce manual testing effort.
* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.

Agile Delivery & Quality Engineering
  
  
  

* Participate actively in backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Review requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to identify test conditions and automation opportunities.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, BAs, and Developers to ensure quality is considered throughout the development lifecycle.

* Validate integrations across upstream and downstream systems.
* Identify test dependencies, risks, and environmental constraints.

* Log, track, and manage defects through resolution.

* Validate operational readiness from a testing perspective.

* Strong experience in automation framework development and maintenance.
* Experience in API, integration, functional, regression, and end-to-end testing.

* Understanding of payment processing and transaction banking systems.
* Experience with SQL, database testing, APIs, and system integrations.
* Knowledge of DevOps, Continuous Testing, and Test Automation best practices.
* Experience working within cross-functional Agile squads.

Success Metrics
  
  

* High-quality, reliable connector framework and integrations

**Position Summary:**

Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai**
**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM and 2 PM to 11 PM**
**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* 4 to 6 years experience in performance testing and engineering roles
* Experience designing, developing, and executing performance test scripts using LoadRunner, JMeter, or NeoLoad
* Experience planning and coordinating performance testing activities, including workload modeling and scenario design
* Experience analyzing test results, identifying bottlenecks, and recommending performance improvements

**About This Role**
We are seeking a Performance Test Engineer to deliver performance and non-functional testing services within VOIS across telecommunications platforms, services and components. You will develop performance test strategies, plans, scripts and scenarios, execute tests and analyse results against agreed quality standards, milestones and service levels.
  
  
The role requires practical experience in performance testing within multinational environments and the ability to work across Cloud, CRM and Middleware domains. You will collaborate with application teams, product owners, IT Operations, developers and multiple vendors to identify performance issues, communicate findings and continuously improve testing practices.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Understand telecommunications technology stacks, delivery approaches and strategic initiatives to define appropriate performance testing strategies
* Plan, script, execute and coordinate performance and non-functional testing activities
* Develop dynamic scripts and realistic performance test scenarios using tools such as LoadRunner, JMeter and SOAP UI
* Analyse non-functional requirements (NFRs), workloads and volumetric requirements to establish appropriate test coverage
* Analyse performance test results and communicate findings clearly in both technical and business language
* Develop and maintain the NFT test strategy, reflecting changes in risks, schedules and testing processes
* Collaborate with application teams to investigate and resolve performance issues
* Monitor application and infrastructure behaviour using APM and diagnostic tools such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, HP Diagnostics and CA Wily
* Support performance analysis across Java/JVM architecture, garbage collection, class loading, thread dumps and Oracle and SQL Server databases
* Work within CI/CD and cloud-based environments using technologies such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Gatling, GitHub and Maven
* Support testing across Kubernetes, microservices, AWS Cloud and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure environments
* Use C, Java, SQL, shell scripting and VB macros where appropriate to customise test scripts and automate processes
* Increase test automation and promote reusable assets, including scripts and input datasets
* Maintain testing deliverables in accordance with agreed methodologies and industry standards
* Identify, document and support the resolution of defects through the agreed defect management process
* Identify lessons learnt, recommend best practices and implement continuous improvements to testing processes
* Communicate risks and issues to project teams, test management and other relevant stakeholders
* Provide regular and ad-hoc progress reporting to the Test Team Lead

**Who You Are**

* You have proven experience delivering performance software testing solutions across multinational and distributed environments
* You have practical experience with performance testing tools such as LoadRunner, JMeter and SOAP UI, including Web HTTP and other relevant protocols
* You understand performance test scripting, execution, analysis and performance bottleneck identification
* You have experience working with CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes and microservices
* You understand Java/JVM performance concepts, databases and application/server performance metrics
* You have experience using application performance monitoring and profiling tools
* You can analyse NFRs and volumetric requirements and translate them into effective performance tests
* You have knowledge of C, Java, SQL, shell scripting and automation techniques
* Experience with supporting diagnostic tools such as Fiddler, browser developer tools, HAR files and Lighthouse would be advantageous
* You understand testing standards and structured defect management practices
* You communicate effectively with product owners, developers, IT Operations, testing professionals and other stakeholders
* You take a thorough, quality-focused and methodical approach to your work
* You can collaborate effectively within a changing, multicultural and matrix organisation
* You are fluent in English and able to communicate technical information to technical and business audiences
* You are able to travel to Europe intermittently where required

**Not a perfect fit?**
Worried that you don’t meet all the desired criteria exactly? At Vodafone we are passionate about empowering people and creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, whatever their personal or professional background. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align exactly with every part of the job description, we encourage you to still apply as you may be the right candidate for this role or another opportunity.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
Opportunity to work on performance engineering within a large-scale telecommunications technology environment.
  
  
Exposure to Cloud, CRM, Middleware, microservices and CI/CD ecosystems.
  
  
Collaboration with multidisciplinary teams, product owners, developers, IT Operations and multiple vendors in an international environment.
  
  
Opportunity to influence performance testing practices through automation, reusable assets and continuous improvement.
  
  
Exposure to projects spanning multiple technologies and geographies.
  
  
**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced performance testing and analysis across telecommunications applications and services
* Performance engineering within cloud-native, Kubernetes and microservices environments
* CI/CD-integrated performance testing and greater test automation
* Deeper application and infrastructure performance analysis using APM and diagnostic tooling
* Performance troubleshooting across Java/JVM and database technologies
* Stakeholder communication and performance reporting within multinational technology programmes
* Development of reusable non-functional testing approaches, assets and continuous improvement practices

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

When you work with us, you’re part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. **Staff Software Development Engineer in Test**
with a proven record of ensuring the delivery of scalable microservice based solutions to enterprise clients. Capable of driving several projects to completion from a QA perspective. A skilled technician that can also serve as a mentor to the team. A visionary that delivers recommendations on how to evolve testing best practices within the organization that solve today’s problems with the future direction of product testing in mind. 

**About the Team:**

You will join our globally disperse engineering team but be supported by engineers based in Pune. We are a results-driven, highly collaborative group passionate about delivering high-impact identity security solutions. Our team develops and tests enterprise products built on a mature, cloud-native, event-driven microservices architecture hosted in AWS. We value individual ownership, teamwork, continuous learning, and technical craftsmanship, providing an environment where your contributions directly shape our product quality. 

**Roadmap for Success:**

* 30 days: Complete engineering onboarding, set up your local development and testing environments, and build an understanding of SailPoint's product capabilities and microservices architecture. Shadow team members on existing testing workflows and execute initial test cases within sprint cycles.
* 60 days: Take ownership of test planning and validation for assigned feature areas. Develop detailed manual and automated test cases covering functional, regression, and integration scenarios, integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines.

* 90 days: Independently drive testing activities across complex microservices features. Partner proactively with development teams to reproduce and triage defects, analyze test metrics, and ensure comprehensive test coverage across supported operating systems and database environments.

* 6 months: Champion automated testing best practices, reduce test execution cycle times, and optimize test harness reliability. Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Management and Engineering leadership to align testing strategy with product delivery goals.

* 1 year: Serve as a subject matter expert for product test engineering and automation frameworks. Drive continuous quality improvements, establish testing standards for new platform capabilities, and mentor team members across the organization.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelors degree in related field, or equivalent professional experience

* 8+ years of professional experience in testing enterprise software, preferably in a Java/J2EE environment

* Proven ability to develop and maintain comprehensive test cases and test harnesses, both manual and automated

* Hands-on experience with one or more automated UI testing frameworks (such as Selenium, Cypress, Karate or equivalent)

* Strong working knowledge of SQL and experience with one or more relational database platforms (such as SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, DB2, or PostgreSQL)

* Hands-on experience configuring test environments, including application servers (such as Tomcat, WebLogic, WebSphere, or JBoss) across Windows Server and Linux/Unix operating systems

* Familiarity with JavaScript, XML, and Java

* Proven ability to work collaboratively with software development engineers for defect reproduction and resolution

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong analytical and diagnostic abilities

**AI-assisted engineering:**

Our engineers are expected to use AI development tools as a core part of their daily workflow, not as a novelty. We expect you to use these tools to accelerate delivery, expand your scope, and raise the quality bar, while applying strong engineering judgment to review, validate, and own everything that ships under your name. Comfort with prompting, agentic workflows, and human-in-the-loop review of AI-generated code is a baseline expectation for this role. 

**AI related Technology:**

* Cursor, Claude Code

* Python-based AI/ML frameworks and libraries such as scikit-learn, pandas, and numpy

* Deep Learning Frameworks such as PyTorch

* LLMs and Foundation Models in Bedrock, VertexAI, or similar

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience with LDAP, Active Directory, or other enterprise identity systems

* Experience testing cloud-native applications hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS)

* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum software development methodologies

**About SailPoint India and our Benefits:**

Nestled in the heart of Pune, a bustling hub of technology and culture, the office exemplifies SailPoint's commitment to excellence. Surrounded by a vibrant atmosphere, the Pune office serves as a strategic center for the company, where cutting-edge solutions are crafted and implemented to address the ever-evolving challenges in identity security. With a team of highly skilled professionals, the office embodies SailPoint's values of Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Individuals. Our Pune team works under a hybrid model enjoying the office 2-3 days a week (unless otherwise specified).  

We provide excellent office amenities, competitive salaries and strong benefits:

* Competitive Compensation

* Paid Leave: Competitive vacation policies alongside paid company holidays to help you recharge.

* Comprehensive Healthcare: Premium medical, dental, and vision insurance options

* Career Growth Opportunities

* Plus so much more!

SailPoint is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified candidates to apply to join our team.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.  

Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. Contact applicationassistance@sailpoint.com or mail to 11120 Four Points Dr, Suite 100, Austin, TX 78726, to discuss reasonable accommodations.  NOTE: Any unsolicited resumes sent by candidates or agencies to this email will not be considered for current openings at SailPoint.

title: R&D Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown!
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Summary**
UBISOFT is seeking an Intermediate R&D Engineer to prototype and validate new technologies that improve game testing and quality control. This role focuses on building rapid prototypes and running experiments using GenAI, VLMs (Vision-Language Models), and AI/ML to explore automation opportunities across QC. You will work closely with the R&D Manager and cross-functional partners to translate ideas into measurable experiments, evaluate feasibility, and iterate toward proof-of-value prototypes. This role provides an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in software development, automation, and quality control processes within the gaming industry.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
**Job Duties / Responsibilities**

* Build rapid prototypes using GenAI/VLM/ML to address QC and testing pain points.
* Design and execute experiments: define hypotheses, datasets/inputs, evaluation criteria, baselines, and success metrics (accuracy, precision/recall, latency, cost, robustness).
* Implement data pipelines for experiments: data collection, cleaning, labeling support, and dataset versioning (as needed for proofs-of-concept).
* Explore and compare approaches and document trade-offs.
* Integrate prototypes with existing internal tools/test systems at a lightweight level (APIs, CLIs, plugins) to enable user trials and feedback.
* Analyze experiment results, identify failure modes, and iterate quickly based on findings and stakeholder input.
* Maintain reproducible research practices: experiment tracking, configuration management, and clear documentation of assumptions and limitations.
* Collaborate in agile workflows: estimate assigned tasks, provide status updates, and incorporate feedback iteratively.

**Learning Opportunities**

* Gain hands-on experience with software development and automation tools.
* Develop a deeper understanding of software testing lifecycles.
* Enhance coding and debugging skills in a collaborative environment.
* Learn about CI/CD pipelines and version control systems.

**Core Competencies**

* Eager to Learn: Highly motivated and quick to grasp new concepts.
* Experimental Mindset: Comfortable with ambiguity; able to form hypotheses and learn quickly through iteration.
* Pragmatic Engineering: Delivers prototypes that are usable and measurable, without over-engineering.
* Analytical Thinking: Interprets results critically; understands bias, variance, and common evaluation pitfalls.
* Collaboration: Works well with technical and non-technical stakeholders; communicates trade-offs clearly.
* Adaptability: Keeps pace with rapidly evolving AI/ML tooling and best practices.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Curiosity: Passion for exploring new technologies and their applications.
* Teamwork: Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams.
* Adaptability: Willingness to take on new challenges and adapt to changing priorities.

**Qualifications**
**Seniority:**
Having at least
**5**
years of coding experience in above languages,
  
  
B.E/BTech/MTech/MS Computer Science in computer science or equivalent.
  
  
**Technical Competencies**

* Hands on Knowledge of Python programming.
* Good understanding of AI/ML concepts.
* Familiarity with software development and testing processes.
* Exposure to CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, TeamCity) and version control systems (e.g., Git).
* Solid understanding of debugging and troubleshooting techniques.
* Good to have understanding of other languages such as C++ and C#.
* Nice to have experience working with game engine

title: Sr. Embedded Test Engineer
description:
Your role
  
  
As a Senior Embedded Test Engineer at Atlas Copco Group, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and reliability of embedded software across a range of advanced industrial products. Your responsibilities include comprehensive verification of embedded software through manual and automated testing, collaboration with cross-disciplinary engineering teams to refine requirements, and the development of Python-based automation to expand regression coverage and enhance testing efficiency.
  
  
You will be embedded within a multidisciplinary team responsible for cutting-edge products such as PLC controllers utilizing CODESYS and Straton, vacuum pump controllers, industrial communication modules, and EtherCAT-based devices. This role demands hands-on expertise in setting up and executing functional, integration, and system tests, managing test artifacts within tools such as Jira Xray, and advancing automated testing frameworks integrated with continuous integration pipelines like TeamCity and Jenkins.
  
  
Your day-to-day tasks will also include thorough analysis of test failures through logs and system behavior observations, defect tracking and retesting, and contributing to the continuous improvement of QA practices and automation tools. You will provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers, influencing quality standards and methodologies across projects.
  
  
Technical and Product Environment
  
  
You will work with embedded operating systems, network stacks, industrial communication protocols (such as Modbus, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, CANopen), hardware interfaces, and automated test systems. This environment balances both legacy and modern technologies, providing a stimulating setting for innovation and technical growth.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Collaborate with product owners and developers during sprint planning to ensure test coverage aligns with acceptance criteria.
* Create, maintain, and execute detailed test plans and cases, both manual and automated, ensuring traceability to requirements.
* Develop and enhance Python-based automation frameworks and scripts to increase regression test efficiency and reliability.
* Perform embedded system testing on physical hardware and hardware simulators, including hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing.
* Analyze, document, and report identified defects, facilitating resolution through close cooperation with the development team.
* Integrate automated tests into continuous integration workflows to provide rapid feedback on software quality.
* Provide technical leadership in QA best practices, contributing to process improvements, and coaching junior QA engineers.
* Maintain detailed test documentation and contribute to project documentation to support compliance and audit requirements.

To succeed, you will need
  
  

* Minimum five years of experience in software testing, with proven expertise in embedded systems and Python automation.
* Strong capability in defining and executing functional, integration, and regression test suites based on user requirements.
* Experience with test management tools such as Jira Xray, defect tracking, and continuous integration systems like TeamCity or Jenkins.
* Ability to independently lead QA activities, prioritize tasks effectively, and provide technical mentorship.
* Familiarity with embedded hardware, communication protocols, and debugging methodologies.

In return, we offer
  
  

* Join a prestigious global industrial leader with a legacy spanning over 150 years, committed to innovation and excellence.
* Empower your professional growth through a culture that encourages autonomy in research and development initiatives.
* Engage in challenging projects developing next-generation embedded systems using advanced technology.
* Experience global exposure and career development opportunities through Atlas Copco's extensive internal mobility network.
* Benefit from a workplace culture that emphasizes mutual care, sustainability, and social responsibility.
* Enjoy a competitive total rewards program, including comprehensive insurance coverage, educational support, and flexible working arrangements to promote work-life balance.

Job location
  
  
This position is based in Pune, India, with a hybrid working model. You will have the flexibility to work partly from our Atlas Copco Group, GECIA premises, and partly remotely. This arrangement supports a healthy work-life balance while maintaining effective collaboration with the onsite team.

title: Embedded Test Engineer
description:
Job Description :
**Embedded Test Engineer.**

Experience required : 1 to 5 years

Location : Pune.

The Systems Engineer (Product V&V (Verification and Validation)) will be a part of the Engineering group that is responsible for implementing technical strategies, evaluate and develop products, and provide a superior level of technical support that benefits the organization. The Systems Engineer will lead the V&V effort / with a Product V&V focus collaborates closely with Engineers, Architects, and Test in the Ventilation business to develop and commercialize Class 2 medical devices.

**Responsibilities:**

* Works together to support product verification and validation planning, resolution of technical integration issues, safety agency interface, system testing and coordination and interfaces with Customer design center.
* Provides engineering expertise in software and system verification and establishes system V&V plans, assists in developments of protocols and reviews reports.
* Implements design for testability by collaborating with R&D (Research and Development) teams to evaluate requirements for testability. Collaborates with external agencies for compliance and safety certification
* Incorporates essential operating mechanisms of systems engineering of medical device design and engineering principles and adheres to medical device regulations.
* Defines system requirements, architecture, and interfaces to meet product requirements, risk analysis and industry standards; conducts system design analysis to select key components and defines control methods; and coordinates build and design integration.
* Conducts design reviews as part of the product development process to ensure customer requirements are met and the designs are manufacture-able, serviceable, and reliable. In addition, it does the same for subsystem requirements and product integration.

Behaviors: The successful candidate will demonstrate the following:

* **Leadership:**
  The ability to make things happen by encouraging and channeling the contributions of others; recognizing and addressing critical issues in a timely manner and acting as an agent for change and continual improvement when required to achieve results.
* **Accountability/Ownership**
  : Work closely with team members and take ownership – be a mentor to junior engineers
* **Influence**
  : The demonstrated ability to gain acceptance and commitment from others to one’s own beliefs and ideas.
* **Negotiating:**
  The ability to construct and maintain a strong bargaining position to ensure positive response and agreement: striving for win-win situations.
* **Adaptability:**
  Must possess the ability to understand new concepts quickly and apply them accurately throughout an evolving environment and organize work assignments to meet established timetables.
* **Data-driven decision-making**
  : ability to move teams through vague and complex situations. Present complex ideas in a simple manner to resolve issues.
* Relentless
  focus on Quality and Transparency
  as an organizational value.

The systems team drives the systems elements of R&D development projects including systems requirement definition and management, architectural definition, control/software/interface product specification and simulation, build integration, system testing and qualification to meet product level requirements.

To succeed in this role, you should have the following skills and experience:

* MS or PhD in relevant field including Computer, Electrical, Mechanical Engineering, or other related science.
* A minimum of 1 to 5 years of experience successfully developing complex medical devices (hardware, software, consumables) products for acute care/hospital markets is necessary.
* Hands-on experience (technical) in ventilation is a plus.
* Knowledge of Statistical Data Analysis is necessary. Includes ability to critically evaluate proposed study designs with basic knowledge of statistics, the calculation of sample sizes and/or estimation of statistical power.
* Experience with conducting cross-discipline feasibility and trade off studies to evaluate electronic, mechanical, and pneumatic performance from subsystem to system level for issue resolutions
* Solid understanding of System Verification and Validation test plan/protocols, executing V&V activities, generating, and analyzing test reports
* Understanding of global medical device regulatory environments and clearance processes.
* Effective communication, documentation, presentation, and interpersonal skills are required, as well as the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
* Experience auditing a DHF (Design History File - a compilation of records which describe the design history of a finished device) for compliance with internal processes and external standards.
* Maintains strict confidentiality of sensitive information.

title: Lead QA
description:
**About Us**

VitalEdge is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions serving the heavy equipment, industrial machinery, dealership, and rental industries. Our ERP, Dealer Management System (DMS), and Integrated Rental platforms help organizations streamline operations, improve customer service, increase profitability, and make data-driven decisions.

Our customers rely on our software to manage equipment sales, rentals, service operations, parts inventory, finance, and customer relationships. As we continue to expand across Australia and the Asia-Pacific region, we are looking for talented Implementation Consultants to help customers successfully adopt and realize value from our solutions.

**Why work for VitalEdge?**

We don’t just sell technology, we enable transformation that results in broader societal benefits like building homes and critical infrastructure, growing food and delivering all sorts of products we all rely on for daily life. We exist to ultimately equip the world to keep running. We have more than 60 years of combined experience and two industry-leading software suites and associated apps, with which we will drive the market forward. It’s an exciting time to work for VitalEdge – join us!

**Position Overview-**

We are seeking a Lead Engineer to provide technical leadership for quality engineering and test automation across our applications. The role will focus on defining automation strategy, improving engineering quality, driving adoption of automated testing, and partnering closely with Engineering, QA, DevOps, and Product teams. The ideal candidate will have practical experience with API and UI automation, while demonstrating strong ownership, architecture, problem-solving, mentoring, and delivery leadership.

**Responsibilities**

· Own and drive the overall quality engineering and automation strategy across products and teams.

· Define technical direction, standards, frameworks, and best practices for automated testing.

· Assess existing quality and automation capabilities and create a roadmap for improving coverage, reliability, and execution efficiency.

· Provide technical leadership to engineers and QA automation teams, including mentoring, coaching, and technical guidance.

· Review and guide automation architecture, framework choices, reusable components, and engineering practices.

· Partner with Engineering, Product, QA, DevOps, and Support teams to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle.

· Drive shift-left quality practices, ensuring testability, automation, and quality considerations are incorporated during design and development.

· Identify quality risks, technical debt, automation gaps, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

· Establish and track engineering quality metrics such as automation coverage, regression execution time, defect leakage, and test stability.

· Lead root-cause analysis for recurring quality issues and drive corrective actions across teams.

· Drive integration of automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and support continuous testing practices.

· Evaluate tools and technologies for improving test efficiency, reliability, maintainability, and developer productivity.

· Coordinate with engineering leadership on release readiness, quality risks, and improvement initiatives.

· Ensure automation assets are scalable, maintainable, reusable, and aligned with enterprise engineering standards.

**Automation Responsibilities**

· Provide hands-on technical guidance for UI automation using Selenium and Java.

· Provide guidance on API automation using REST Assured and REST API testing.

· Support automation for web and mobile applications where required.

· Review and improve existing automation frameworks, test suites, and reusable utilities.

· Guide implementation of functional, regression, smoke, and integration automation.

· Ensure automated tests are integrated into CI/CD pipelines and provide actionable test results.

Required Technical Skills

· Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience working with enterprise applications.

· Good hands-on experience with UI automation, preferably Selenium with Java.

· Good experience with API automation and REST API testing; REST Assured experience is preferred.

· Understanding of automation framework architecture, test design, and maintainable automation practices.

· Experience with Git and CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions.

· Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.

· Good understanding of Agile/Scrum development practices.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

· Ability to influence engineering teams without relying solely on formal authority.
