title: Performance Testing Engineer
description:
**About Position:** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced Performance Engineer with 5 to 10 years of expertise in Performance Testing, Application Monitoring, and Performance Optimization. The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience with NeoLoad, Dynatrace, and Kubernetes and will be responsible for ensuring application scalability, reliability, and operational excellence. This role requires a proactive professional who can design and execute performance testing strategies, analyze system bottlenecks, and collaborate with development and QA teams to drive continuous performance improvements across enterprise applications.
 



  




* **Role: Performance Testing Engineer (NeoLoad \& Dynatrace)**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 5 to 10 Years**
* **Job Type: Full\-Time Employment**



  





**What You'll Do:** 




  




* Design, develop, and execute performance test plans using NeoLoad to validate application scalability, reliability, and performance.
* Perform load, stress, endurance, scalability, and capacity testing for enterprise applications.
* Monitor application performance using Dynatrace and proactively identify bottlenecks, latency issues, and optimization opportunities.
* Analyze application, infrastructure, and database performance metrics.
* Collaborate with Development, QA, DevOps, and Infrastructure teams to integrate performance testing within the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Develop performance testing strategies and frameworks to improve testing efficiency and coverage.
* Analyze performance test results and prepare detailed reports with actionable recommendations.
* Troubleshoot complex performance issues and perform root cause analysis.

* Support performance validation activities during releases and production deployments.
* Continuously improve performance testing tools, frameworks, and methodologies.

* Mentor junior team members on performance testing concepts, tools, and best practices.
* Stay updated with the latest trends, tools, and technologies in performance engineering and observability.



  





**Expertise You'll Bring:** 




  




* 5 to 10 years of experience in Performance Engineering and Performance Testing.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in NeoLoad for designing, scripting, executing, and analyzing performance tests.
* Proficiency in Dynatrace for application performance monitoring, observability, troubleshooting, and bottleneck analysis.
* Experience working with Kubernetes environments and containerized applications.
* Deep understanding of Load Testing, Stress Testing, Endurance Testing, Scalability Testing, and Capacity Testing methodologies.
* Strong experience analyzing performance metrics, application logs, and infrastructure utilization data.
* Ability to identify root causes of performance issues and provide optimization recommendations.
* Experience integrating performance testing into Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD\-driven delivery environments.
* Strong knowledge of application architecture, web technologies, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Experience monitoring application performance across cloud and on\-premises environments.
* Strong analytical, debugging, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience creating detailed performance reports and presenting findings to technical and business stakeholders.
* Proven ability to improve application scalability, reliability, and operational performance.
* Experience mentoring and guiding performance testing teams.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working within Agile and Scrum methodologies.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience.



  





**Benefits:** 




  




* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check\-ups

 Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.
 



  




* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.

* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

title: Automation Test Analyst
description:
**Job Description** 

**Company:** 

 AskTalos
 




**Location:** 

 Remote – Work From Home
 




**Experience:** 

 2 to 4 Years
 




**Working Days:** 

 Monday to Saturday
 




  




**About AskTalos** 

**Empowering Businesses with AI\-Driven Communication Solutions** 





 AskTalos is a B2B SaaS platform that brings CRM, AI voice calling, WhatsApp, email, and chatbot workflows together in one place. Companies use it to improve customer engagement and grow revenue faster.
 





 We want to change how businesses talk to their customers. With chat, calling, email, WhatsApp, and CRM in one intelligent platform, customer communication becomes simple, efficient, and effective. Startups and enterprises alike use AskTalos to automate operations, get more done, and put AI to work across their business.
 




  




**The Role** 


 We're hiring an
 
**Automation Tester** 

 to own the quality of the AskTalos platform. It's a live product with real businesses running their sales and customer communication on it every day. You'll build and maintain automation frameworks, test complex multi\-channel workflows (AI calls, WhatsApp messages, CRM updates, email sequences), and make sure every release is stable before it reaches customers.
 





 This role suits someone who enjoys breaking things before customers can, who thinks in edge cases, and who wants hands\-on exposure to AI voice agents and automation products.
 




  




**Key Responsibilities** 
* Design, build, and maintain
 
**scalable UI automation frameworks** 

 for our React\-based web application, using Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress
* Write and run
 
**API automation tests** 

 for our Django/REST backend with Postman, Rest Assured, or PyTest
* Test
 
**end\-to\-end business workflows** 

 across channels, e.g. AI call → auto WhatsApp message → CRM record update → follow\-up trigger
* Create and maintain
 
**test plans, test cases, and test data** 

 for new features, integrations, and bug fixes
* Own
 
**regression, smoke, and sanity suites** 

 , and run them before every release
* Validate
 
**third\-party integrations** 

 : WhatsApp Business API, telephony/voice providers, email services, webhooks, and external CRMs
* Do
 
**database testing** 

 with SQL to verify data integrity across CRM modules
* Plug automation suites into
 
**CI/CD pipelines** 

 (GitHub Actions / Jenkins) so tests run on every build
* Log, track, and retest defects in
 
**JIRA** 

 (or a similar tool), with clear reproduction steps, logs, and screenshots
* Work closely with developers and product in
 
**Agile sprints** 

 , joining sprint planning, reviews, and release sign\-offs
* Contribute to
 
**basic performance and load testing** 

 of key pages and APIs (JMeter / k6 is a plus)
* Do
 
**exploratory testing** 

 on new AI features where outputs aren't always deterministic



  




**Must\-Have Skills** 
* **2 –4 years** 

 of hands\-on QA experience, with at least
 
**2 years in automation testing**
* Strong experience with at least one UI automation tool:
 
**Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, or Cypress**
* Good programming skills in
 
**Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript**
* Experience with test frameworks such as
 
**TestNG, JUnit, PyTest, or Mocha** 

 , and design patterns like
 
**Page Object Model**
* Solid
 
**API testing** 

 experience (REST, JSON, status codes, auth tokens) using Postman and/or code\-based tools
* Working knowledge of
 
**SQL** 

 for backend data validation
* Familiarity with
 
**Git** 

 and running tests in
 
**CI/CD pipelines**
* Clear understanding of
 
**STLC, SDLC, defect life cycle** 

 , and Agile/Scrum
* Strong analytical skills and a sharp eye for detail
* Good written and verbal communication, since you'll report bugs clearly and work remotely with the team



  




**Good to Have** 
* Experience testing
 
**SaaS / CRM / multi\-tenant web applications**
* Exposure to
 
**WhatsApp Business API, IVR/telephony, or voice\-calling systems**
* Experience testing
 
**AI/LLM\-based features** 

 or chatbots
* Knowledge of
 
**performance testing** 

 tools (JMeter, k6, Lighthouse)
* Experience with
 
**mobile/responsive testing** 

 and cross\-browser testing (BrowserStack / LambdaTest)
* Basic knowledge of
 
**Django or React** 

 application architecture
* ISTQB certification



  




**What We Offer** 
* **Competitive salary**
* **100% remote working** 

 , from anywhere in India
* **Direct exposure to real\-world AI and automation projects**
* Hands\-on work with
 
**AI Voice Agents, CRM, WhatsApp automation, chatbots, and email automation.**
* **Ownership:** 

 your work directly affects a product used by real businesses
* A
 
**fast\-paced, collaborative, growth\-oriented** 

 startup environment
* A chance to grow into a
 
**QA Lead** 

 role as the team scales



  




**Who Should Apply** 


 You're a good fit if you have 2–4 years of testing experience, have built or maintained automation suites yourself (not only run them), and want to work on AI\-powered SaaS products instead of routine service\-company projects.
 




  





**Immediate joiners or candidates with a notice period of up to 30 days will be preferred.**

 Development

 Pune, India
   

  




**Description**
 ParentPay Group is Europe’s leading software product company and the UK’s largest education technology business. We are on a mission to bring next\-generation innovation to positively impact on the lives of millions of parents, teachers, and students every day in over 49 countries.
   

  

 Our market leading products use cutting edge cloud\-based technology to streamline school processes, including secure web and mobile apps that enable secure online payments for school items such as meals, trips, clubs and uniform, improve parental engagement, simplify meal management and \- through our product SIMS \- collect and manage a database of student information and core school operations.
   

  

 ParentPay Group’s new offices in Pune are a fantastic tech hub for those looking to boost their careers in software product development.
   

  

 Our bright team FastTrack their career with international exposure and ways of working based on agile development best practices from globally renowned technology consultancies.

 We are looking for an experienced Software Consultant who is passionate about building products that deliver exceptional customer experience.
   

  

 You will contribute towards creating test scenarios, manual Testing, automating the scenarios and benchmarking the performance of products and services in the ParentPay group portfolio.
   

  

 You will be responsible for understanding the domain as well as technical intricacies of the product working on the product backlog, and aid in delivery acceleration through creative thinking, an evidence\-based approach and a keen focus on user and business value.
   

  

 The product will deliver a new API interface for all group solutions, so alongside customer facing elements there will need to be a firm technical foundation. A solid understanding of technical principles and an ability to converse and work with solutions and technical requirements is therefore essential to success.

 ·Demonstrate clarity of thought and the ability to translate the complex into simple and consistent terms.

title: Staff Engineer – Customer Engineering
description:
Staff Engineer – Customer Engineering (Data \& AI Security Platforms)
 



**Location:** 
 Pune, India · Hybrid
 



**Reports to:** 
 Field CTO \& Head of Customer Experience · Engineering Ladder, calibrated with Engineering
 



 Role Summary
 



 Trust3 AI builds software that large enterprises use to control who can reach which data — across Databricks, Snowflake, AWS Lake Formation, BigQuery, Trino and more. It runs in production inside some of the world's largest banks, insurers, retailers and healthcare companies.
 



 We are creating Customer Engineering, and you will be the first engineer in it. You will own a defined piece of that platform end to end — the connectors and integrations our enterprise customers run, the tooling around them, and everything it takes to make them fast, reliable and easy to operate.
 



 Design, build, ship, run, fix, improve, with no handoffs. Two engineers will join you to deliver it; the accountability stays yours.
 



 Real workloads and real telemetry mean you never have to guess what to improve. Your job is to take software that works today and make it excellent — quicker to deploy, harder to break, cheaper to run.
 



 We build with AI: coding assistants and agents are part of the daily toolchain here, and we expect them to show up in what you ship.
 



 What You'll Own
 


* The connectors and integrations customers run — quality, performance, release validation, security posture. If something is wrong with them it is yours, and so is the decision about how to fix it.
* Delivery speed. Customer\-driven fixes and features shipped in weeks rather than release cycles, and custom connectors and integrations built to customer timelines.
* The hard problems. Connector failures, policy\-sync faults, performance collapse, upgrade breakage — deep debugging, root cause, permanent fix.
* Deployment and operations. Install, upgrade and rollback automation across self\-managed, SaaS and air\-gapped estates; telemetry, alerting and dashboards covering connector health, performance and CVE exposure.
* Proving it works, and works at scale. Functional and scalability testing of what you own is yours, not someone else's gate to pass — the suites, the load profiles that reflect real customer volumes, and the evidence that a release is safe to ship.
* Scale, efficiency and toil. JVM and connector profiling, throughput and resource envelopes at enterprise identity and policy volumes — and engineering away the procedures we repeat across customers, through self\-healing behaviour rather than better runbooks.
* The technical call, and the team. What gets fixed, engineered away, declined or raised to Platform Engineering is your call; that boundary is agreed at leadership level, not renegotiated ticket by ticket. You will hire and technically lead a connector engineer and a DevOps engineer.



 The Engineering Bar
 



 Working software is the starting point, not the finish line. We want an engineer whose services are:
 


* **Deployable** 
 — installs, upgrades and rolls back cleanly, without a runbook only the author can follow
* **Scalable** 
 — holds at enterprise volumes and degrades predictably rather than falling over
* **Lightweight** 
 — a modest footprint and resource envelopes that match the work being done, not the worst case someone once hit
* **Enterprise\-ready** 
 — hardened images, current dependencies, a clean CVE posture, and the evidence a customer's security team will ask for
* **Provably correct** 
 — behaviour pinned down by tests you wrote, verified at customer\-scale volumes before a customer finds the limit
* **Supportable** 
 — diagnosable from logs and metrics by someone who did not write it
* **Self\-healing** 
 — any manual procedure we run twice is a defect: the second time it should be automated, the third time it should not be possible



 Platform reliability is the customer's experience of us. The measure of this role is not how fast you perform an operational task, but how quickly you make it unnecessary.
 



 Skills Required
 



 Real depth in the core, and the credibility to pick up the rest. Nobody has all of this.
 



**Core:** 



* Java and Spring at depth
* Microservices design and the reality of operating them
* Kubernetes and Helm in production
* Prometheus and Grafana
* JVM debugging — heap and thread analysis, GC behaviour, connection handling under load
* Linux
* Python or Bash



**Data platforms, depth in at least one:** 



* Databricks (Unity Catalog or SQL warehouses)
* Snowflake
* AWS Lake Formation
* BigQuery
* Trino/Presto
* Spark
* Or comparable



**Cloud, production depth in at least one:** 



* AWS, Azure or GCP
* IAM
* Networking
* Managed Kubernetes



**Testing:** 



* Functional, integration and load testing you build and own
* Test automation in CI
* Maturity in spec\-driven or behaviour\-driven development is a strong plus — we would rather the expected behaviour be written down and executable than live in someone's head



**Operations:** 



* CI/CD
* TLS and certificate handling
* Container image hardening
* Dependency and CVE remediation
* AI\-assisted engineering as part of how you work



**Access control, familiarity is enough:** 



* RBAC
* ABAC or tag\-based policy
* Row and column level access
* Masking
* Enterprise SSO



 We will teach you the governance domain; we cannot teach you ten years of production engineering.
 



 Experience
 


* 8\+ years building and operating production software, including time on systems you did not write
* Deep ownership of production failures in enterprise environments, with direct customer contact throughout
* Built Java microservices that other people deployed, scaled and supported without you in the room
* Raised the engineering standard of a live, revenue\-carrying product — you can say what you changed, in what order, and how you did it without stopping delivery
* Comfortable as the senior technical voice in front of a customer's platform and security teams



 Why This Role
 


* Genuine end\-to\-end ownership — one accountable owner, one piece of software, design through production, as a founding mandate
* Staff\-level and hands\-on — you lead technically, sit on the engineering ladder, and write code every week
* You define the function — what it takes on, what it refuses, and who joins it
* Problems with teeth, and impact you can see — enterprise\-scale identity and policy volumes, JVM behaviour under load, multi\-cloud deployment, security hardening against demanding review; what you ship reaches production customers in weeks



 Location
 



**Pune, India · Hybrid** 




**Reports to:** 
 Field CTO \& Head of Customer Experience · Engineering ladder, calibrated with Engineering

title: Sr. Software Quality Automation Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
 IntegriChain is the data and application backbone for market access departments of Life Sciences manufacturers. We deliver the data, the applications, and the business process infrastructure for patient access and therapy commercialization. More than 250 manufacturers rely on our ICyte Platform to orchestrate their commercial and government payer contracting, patient services, and distribution channels. ICyte is the first and only platform that unites the financial, operational, and commercial data sets required to support therapy access in the era of specialty and precision medicine. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators can digitalize their market access operations, freeing up resources to focus on more data\-driven decision support. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators are digitalizing labor\-intensive processes – freeing up their best talent to identify and resolve coverage and availability hurdles and to manage pricing and forecasting complexity.
   

  

 We are headquartered in Philadelphia, PA (USA), with offices in: Ambler, PA (USA); Pune, India; and Medellín, Colombia. For more information, visit www.integrichain.com, or follow us on Twitter @IntegriChain and LinkedIn.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Work alongside AI agents as co\-workers within our AI\-SDLC framework — using Anthropic Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and AWS Bedrock throughout design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance cycles
* Drive work from Jira tickets and Confluence documentation as the source of truth for requirements, decisions, and context
* Leverage deep domain and product knowledge to evaluate and challenge requirements — ensuring they are precise, complete, and structured for effective processing by both human engineers and AI agents
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies — sprint planning, stand\-ups, retrospectives, and backlog refinement — to keep delivery on track and priorities aligned
* Surface and mitigate quality risks before they escalate — proactively communicating test coverage gaps, flagging scope concerns during planning, and helping keep the team's quality commitments on track
* Own the test strategy and automation architecture with data quality as the primary focus — spanning ETL/ELT pipeline validation, source\-to\-target reconciliation, functional, end\-to\-end (Playwright), BDD, and performance (JMeter) layers
* Build and maintain robust Python\-based test frameworks and BDD feature suites — including reusable SQL and pandas/PySpark assertion libraries for data comparison, profiling, and reconciliation — that align test coverage to biopharma business requirements
* Design and govern JMeter performance test plans covering both application and data layers — pipeline throughput, load\-window adherence, and large\-volume query response; analyse results and drive remediation with development teams
* Own end\-to\-end data quality across the platform's ingestion and transformation pipelines — designing and automating validation of raw, staged, and curated layers in Snowflake and PostgreSQL
* Write and own the complex SQL that proves business logic independently of the pipeline code — reconciling source, staging, and curated layers rather than trusting transformation output at face value
* Build automated reconciliation suites covering row counts, control totals, referential integrity, deduplication, late\-arriving data, slowly changing dimension handling, and idempotency on pipeline reruns
* Design and maintain reusable test data — synthetic and masked production\-like datasets that exercise edge cases, nulls, boundary values, historical restatements, and malformed or out of\-spec source files
* Validate orchestration behaviour end\-to\-end — dependency ordering, retries, partial\-load recovery, backfills, incremental vs. full loads, and failure alerting
* Test schema evolution and data contracts between upstream sources and downstream consumers, catching breaking changes before they reach client\-facing outputs
* Define, automate, and report on data quality rules and SLAs — completeness, accuracy, timeliness, uniqueness, and conformity — making data quality visible to the team and to stakeholders
* Serve as the go\-to QA engineer for the harder test challenges — the person the team relies on when data complexity, regulatory risk, or system ambiguity is highest
* Produce clear test strategy documents, defect trend analyses, and quality reports that inform team and stakeholder decisions; communicate quality status and risk effectively to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Incorporate pharma manufacturer client needs and regulatory requirements into test coverage decisions; participate actively in incident responses and quality reviews that have direct client impact
* Apply strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to trace data defects back to root cause through the pipeline — distinguishing source data issues from transformation logic defects and orchestration failures — anticipating failure modes and designing coverage for them proactively rather than reactively; evaluate quality trade\-offs and drive decisions with appropriate rigour
* Demonstrate full accountability for your own work and the team's quality output — holding yourself answerable to team\-level quality outcomes, not just individual test deliverables; proactively managing risks, communicating progress, and owning quality end\-to\-end
* Lift the overall quality output of the team — through proactive test design collaboration, knowledge sharing, unblocking, and consistently raising the bar on what the team ships
* Stay current with the team's evolving test toolset — including AI\-augmented testing practices, Playwright updates, BDD patterns, and biopharma regulatory developments — and actively bring relevant updates into team practices
* Partner effectively across backend developers, UI/UX developers, product analysts, and domain stakeholders — communicating clearly within a geographically distributed team
* Mentor junior QA engineers and champion quality best practices across the team
* Evaluate and integrate AI\-powered testing tools into the QA workflow


**Qualifications**
* 7\+ years in software quality engineering, with the majority of that time spent on data\-centric testing — ETL/ELT pipelines, data warehouses, and reporting/consumption layers. Strong expertise in requirement analysis, test data design, test planning, and detailed test case design across automation and manual testing.
* Any experience with AWS/Cloud hosted applications is an added advantage.
* Expert\-level SQL (MUST) — able to independently write and tune complex queries against Snowflake, PostgreSQL and MySQL (multi\-table joins over large fact/dimension tables, window functions, CTEs, aggregations, set operations) to validate transformation logic without depending on developers
* 4\+ years specifically testing data pipelines / ETL\-ELT processes end\-to\-end — source\-to\-target mapping validation, reconciliation, data quality rule design, and root\-cause analysis of data defects
* Hands\-on experience with a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake strongly preferred) — comfortable with stages, streams, tasks, time travel, clustering, and reading query profiles for tuning
* Working knowledge of pipeline orchestration and transformation tooling (Airflow, dbt, AWS Glue, Step Functions, or equivalent) and of common ingestion formats (CSV, fixed\-width, JSON, Parquet; EDI/X12 an advantage)
* Python data\-handling skills applied to testing — pandas, PySpark, or equivalent — for building comparison, profiling, and reconciliation utilities at scale
* Exposure to data quality frameworks such as Great Expectations, dbt tests, or Soda, or experience building equivalent in\-house capability
* 3\+ years of test automation across UI and API layers — creating, executing, and maintaining automated tests with Selenium WebDriver (v3\+)/Playwright, with programming experience in Python (MUST) — complementing, not replacing, the core data testing focus
* Deep BDD expertise — framework design, Gherkin authoring, step library architecture, living documentation
* Proven JMeter experience — test plan design, distributed execution, and results analysis
* Hands\-on experience working in an AI\-augmented or agentic development/testing environment (e.g. Claude Code, Copilot, AWS Bedrock, or equivalent)
* Experienced working with Agile methodologies, such as Scrum, Kanban
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a track record of owning data quality outcomes end\-to\-end — accountable to team\-level quality outcomes, not just individual deliverables
* Influences technical decisions on the team through well\-supported proposals and demonstrated expertise; beginning to shape team practices through example and mentorship
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills within a geographically distributed, cross functional team
* Key competencies required: Problem\-Solving, Analytical, Collaboration, and Accountability. Strong communication skills \& stakeholder management. Advantage if,
* Has Healthcare/Life Sciences domain experience — particularly pharma commercial data (distributor 867/852 files, chargebacks, claims, gross\-to\-net, or master data management)
* Has experience designing and enhancing test automation frameworks, especially data validation frameworks built in\-house
* Team leading experience Professional Approach
* Ready to work in flexible working hours and collaborate with US/India/Colombia teams
* Good communication skills (written, verbal, listening, and articulation)


 Additional Information
   

  

**What does IntegriChain have to offer?**
* Mission driven: Work with the purpose of helping to improve patients' lives!
* Excellent and affordable medical benefits \+ non\-medical perks including Flexible Paid Time Off and much more!
* Robust Learning \& Development opportunities including over 700\+ development courses free to all employees


 IntegriChain is committed to equal treatment and opportunity in all aspects of recruitment, selection, and employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ethnicity, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law. IntegriChain is an equal opportunity employer; committed to creating a community of inclusion, and an environment free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

title: Software Solutions Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Software Solutions Engineer to support NVIDIA AI Enterprise customers and deployments across cloud and datacenter environments. This is a dual role: (1\) Support, triage and resolve complex customer software issues end\-to\-end, and (2\) build software features, automation, diagnostics, reproducible test cases, and deployment tooling—to improve product readiness and scale support across enterprise environments.
   

  

 You will work across compute and cloud\-native technologies in CSP environments, including container platforms/orchestrators, enterprise system software, and GPU\-accelerated AI frameworks and inference services used to run production AI workloads at scale. In this customer\-facing role, you will work closely with customers and internal engineering teams to understand issues, explain root causes, drive resolution, and collaborate on fixes and improvements. Success in this role requires strong debugging skills, crisp communication, and ownership of technically deep escalations from inception to closure.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Develop and maintain product\-facing features and deployment assets for AI Enterprise supportability (e.g., scripts, configuration guidance, Kubernetes manifests/Helm charts, and reproducible test cases)
* Develop and maintain Python\-based tooling/automation (validators, log collectors, repro harnesses) to improve NVIDIA AI Enterprise deployment reliability across NGC and container orchestrators (e.g., Kubernetes)
* Contribute code\-level fixes, patches, or pull requests (as appropriate) in collaboration with engineering to address customer\-impacting issues and improve product readiness
* Support enterprise customers deploying NVIDIA AI Enterprise in datacenter and CSP environments, including Kubernetes\-based and containerized production AI platforms
* Take ownership of customer issues from inception to resolution: reproduce in lab/cloud, collect diagnostics, provide mitigations, and partner with engineering on fixes
* Create high\-quality bug reports and RFEs with clear repro steps, environment details (CSP/Kubernetes/GPU), impact analysis, and supporting artifacts
* Develop customer\-facing and internal documentation (KBs, runbooks, deployment guidance) to improve time\-to\-value and reduce recurring issues
* Be on call one weekend per month in the event a customer has a Sev1 outage and requires engineering assistance


**What We Need To See**
* BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* At least 5\+ years system software development and troubleshooting experience, ideally with some customer facing
* Strong computer science fundamentals and programming/scripting skills (Python required; Bash; Go/C\+\+ a plus) to automate investigations and build diagnostics/repro tools
* Strong troubleshooting fundamentals (networking, concurrency, OS concepts) and a structured approach to isolating issues across application, platform, and infrastructure layers
* Deep understanding of at least two of the following: data centers/servers, distributed systems, virtualization, deep learning frameworks, containers (Docker/Kubernetes), hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD for reliable deployments
* Familiarity with GPU\-accelerated AI/ML stacks and production model deployment/serving (e.g., NGC containers, CUDA/tooling concepts, inference serving such as Triton or similar)
* Deep Linux knowledge and comfort troubleshooting in production Linux environments; working knowledge of Windows is a plus
* Professional\-level communication skills, interpersonal skills with a passion to solve problems


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Hands\-on experience deploying and operating NVIDIA AI Enterprise components in production across on\-prem or CSP environments
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants/tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) to accelerate debugging, automation, and test creation
* Experience operating Kubernetes\-based platforms in production (cluster operations, upgrades, control\-plane/data\-plane failure modes)
* Strong performance debugging skills for GPU and cloud workloads (profiling, latency/throughput tuning) and familiarity with observability/tracing tools

title: Team Lead - Engineering
description:
**About Tripstack \-** 
 Founded in Toronto, Canada in 2016, Tripstack has been part of Etraveli Group since 2019\. It is a B2B Flights as a Service provider and a world leader in virtual interlining. Operating from offices in Canada, India, and Poland, Tripstack is the gateway into Etraveli Group’s world leading tech platform \- giving partners access to global flight content, virtual interlining, and a full suite of services including payments, fraud prevention, pricing, and customer support. As a world leader in virtual interlining technology, Tripstack connects non\-partner, low\-cost and full\-service carriers, enabling the creation of unique and flexible itineraries through a simple, cost\-effective API. Its technology ingest over 30B price points and handles over 240 million searches daily. Through partnerships with airlines, OTAs, and other distribution channels across the globe, Tripstack expands networks, drives new revenue streams, and offers more choice at competitive prices, all backed by robust technology and traveler protection. For more information, visit: www.tripstack.com ,www.etraveligroup.com
   

  

**Role Overview :** 
 As a Technical Lead on the Content team, you will architect software that ensures people can find the best flight combinations, as well as making Tripstack's software solid and scalable. A successful candidate will thrive in and help lead fast\-paced environments that leverage agile planning techniques, encourage and reward creative design and intelligent risk taking, and find innovative ways to leverage cutting\-edge technology. You will lead a high\-performing team to ensure our systems are scalable and low\-latency. You will drive the technical roadmap, mentor senior engineers, and balance innovative feature development with technical debt management.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Ensure high\-quality delivery by owning the development from ideation, planning, design, implementation, and quality assurance to post\-production monitoring.
* Ensure the team's technical decisions are consistently correct, and revisit them when the context changes.
* Unblock the team on technical ambiguity by resolving it quickly and directly.
* Strategize and support the team in unblocking itself using existing company resources and cross team collaboration.
* Author and approve code and designs that rarely require architectural rework after release.
* Ensure the team's solutions follow code guidelines and apply secure and defensive coding practices as a default.
* Build scalable, low\-latency, fault\-tolerant systems empirically proven through load and stress testing.
* Flag known tradeoffs before they become incidents.
* Track, plan, and resolve tech debt consciously so that it doesn’t pile up.
* Ensure the team's releases are monitored, documented, and supportable.
* Act as scrum master for the team.
* Improve the SDLC and project workflow for the team and group.
* Create an inclusive environment where every engineer can contribute and be heard.
* Promote team building and a durable team culture.
* Encourage responsible AI adoption within the team.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**About Kaseya**
 Kaseya is the leading provider of AI\-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long\-term business success.
   

  

 Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double\-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.
   

  

 Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders \- and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.
   

  

 We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better \- a product, a process, a career \- you'll fit right in.
   

  

 At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Kaseya is seeking a Senior Software Engineer – DevTest / QA Automation to design, build, and maintain robust automated testing capabilities across enterprise software platforms.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on software engineering role focused on test automation and engineering quality. The ideal candidate will have a strong programming background and be capable of building test libraries, automation frameworks, test infrastructure, and large scale automated test suites.
   

  

 The role requires an engineer who can leverage AI assisted development tools and coding agents to accelerate automation, analyze existing codebases, generate and validate test scenarios, and rapidly expand automated coverage. The candidate should be comfortable working across application code, test infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments, and production troubleshooting.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be able to take an existing codebase and, with limited direction, deliver hundreds of meaningful automated test cases within weeks, while maintaining quality, reliability, and maintainability.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks, test libraries, utilities, and reusable automation components.
* Build comprehensive automated test suites for enterprise SaaS applications, APIs, services, integrations, and distributed systems.
* Write production\-quality code to automate functional, integration, regression, API, and system\-level testing.
* Analyze existing application codebases and rapidly identify opportunities for automated test coverage.
* Develop and execute large\-scale automation initiatives capable of delivering hundreds of automated test cases in a short timeframe.
* Leverage AI coding assistants and AI agents extensively to accelerate test development, test generation, code analysis, debugging, and automation engineering.
* Validate AI\-generated code and test cases through appropriate engineering practices, including code review, execution, debugging, and test\-result analysis.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and test execution infrastructure.
* Work with CI/CD runners, build systems, deployment pipelines, test environments, and automation reporting.
* Develop automation that can run reliably in continuous integration and deployment environments.
* Troubleshoot automation failures, application issues, environment problems, and production defects using logs, metrics, traces, code, and system behavior.
* Participate in production troubleshooting and issue reproduction, including supporting incidents or reproducing customer issues outside standard working hours when required.
* Collaborate closely with software engineers, architects, product managers, DevOps, operations, and other QA/DevTest engineers to identify quality risks and improve engineering practices.
* Contribute to improvements in testability, observability, reliability, performance, and maintainability of the product.
* Identify gaps in existing test coverage and proactively create automation to prevent regression.
* Review application and test code and provide technical feedback on quality, maintainability, reliability, and automation effectiveness.
* Continuously improve automation speed, stability, coverage, and execution efficiency.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of software engineering, SDET, DevTest, or QA automation experience, with strong hands\-on programming experience.
* Programming skills in one or more languages such as Java, C\#, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar.
* Demonstrated experience building automation frameworks, test libraries, reusable testing components, and automation infrastructure.
* Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including object\-oriented programming, data structures, APIs, databases, debugging, and version control.
* Experience developing automated tests for APIs, backend services, web applications, distributed systems, or enterprise software.
* Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution, including familiarity with CI/CD runners and build/deployment infrastructure.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS or other cloud environments, with the ability to troubleshoot applications and test environments in the cloud.
* Experience troubleshooting complex application and production issues using logs, metrics, traces, database queries, and code level debugging.
* Ability to understand an existing codebase and independently build significant automated test coverage.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI assisted development tools/coding agents as part of day to day engineering and test automation work.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills with the ability to identify root causes rather than simply report failures.
* Strong understanding of test automation principles, test design, regression testing, and automation reliability.
* Ability to work collaboratively with engineering and cross functional teams.
* Willingness to support production issue reproduction and troubleshooting outside standard working hours when required.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working on enterprise SaaS, IT management, cybersecurity, endpoint management, RMM, or other complex software platforms.
* Deep experience with AWS services and cloud\-hosted, data center hosted, or hybrid environments.
* Experience designing and maintaining large\-scale SDET/DevTest automation frameworks.
* Experience with API automation, integration testing, contract testing, service virtualization, or distributed\-system testing.
* Experience with tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, REST\-assured, pytest, JUnit, TestNG, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized test environments.
* Experience with CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases, including writing queries for test validation and production troubleshooting.
* Experience using AI coding agents to perform tasks such as code generation, test generation, codebase analysis, debugging, refactoring, and test optimization.
* Understanding of application security, scalability, reliability, observability, and distributed\-system behavior.
* Experience building automation capable of operating at significant scale without excessive flakiness or maintenance overhead.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive automation initiatives from design through implementation and production adoption.


**Additional Information**
*Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

title: Senior Software Test Engineer
description:
**Job description for Lead/ Senior Test Engineer** 




**About PaperLite** 




  





 PaperLite is an enterprise\-software / SaaS startup based in Pune, founded in 2023, focused on workflow automation and enterprise collaboration solutions. We help organizations streamline notifications, task management, document tracking, secure file sharing, communication, data security \& encryption, access control, client management, and more.
 



 As a growing team, we’re building scalable infrastructure and systems to support our platform (for ourselves and our customers), and we are looking for a Lead/ Senior Test Engineer who can help make everything robust, automated, secure, and efficient.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We're looking for a
 **Senior Test Engineer** 
 who is equally comfortable doing hands\-on manual testing and building robust automation frameworks. You'll own quality across the product lifecycle: understanding requirements, shaping test strategy, writing and maintaining automated tests (primarily in Playwright), and integrating them into our CI/CD pipelines. You'll work closely with developers, product managers, business analyst and designers to make sure we ship reliable, high\-quality software.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Analyse business and technical requirements and participate in grooming and design discussions to identify testability gaps and risks early.
* Define test plans, test strategies, and test coverage for features, releases, and regression cycles.
* Perform hands\-on manual testing, including functional, exploratory, regression, integration, and UAT support.
* Identify test scope, risks, dependencies, and appropriate testing approaches for new features and releases.
* Design, build, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI and API testing, with Playwright as the preferred tool.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps) and keep them fast, stable, and trustworthy.
* Write clear, reproducible defect reports, track them to closure, and help with root\-cause analysis.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (engineering, product, DevOps, design, analysts, support) to align on quality goals and release readiness.
* Monitor and report quality metrics such as test coverage, defect trends, and flaky\-test rates.
* Mentor junior QA team members and promote testing best practices across the team.
* Contribute to performance and load testing efforts where needed.
* Participate in and contribute to agile/scrum ceremonies.



  
 



**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




  




* 5\+ years of total experience in software testing / quality assurance.
* Strong hands\-on experience in both manual and automation testing. This is not a purely automation or purely manual role.
* Proficiency in automation using Playwright (preferred), or comparable tools such as Cypress, Selenium, or WebdriverIO, with willingness to work primarily in Playwright.
* Good Experience with mobile automation using Appium or comparable tools.
* Solid programming skills in JavaScript/TypeScript (preferred), Python, or Java.
* Experience with API testing using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or Playwright's API testing capabilities.
* Hands\-on experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Proven ability to create test plans, test strategies, and test cases from requirements.
* Experience with version control (Git) and test/defect management tools (e.g., Jira, TestRail, Zephyr).
* Experience with load and performance testing tools such as k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to think like an end user.
* Excellent communication skills and experience working with cross\-functional teams.
* Deep understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and the SDLC.
* Experience with version control systems, preferably Git.
* Basic SQL knowledge for backend and data validation.
* Familiarity with visual regression, accessibility, or security testing.
* Ability to gel and work in a team and assist junior team members on techno\-functional grounds.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Good analytical skills with strong attention to detail.



  





**What We Value in You** 




  




* Strong problem\-solving \& troubleshooting instincts
* Great communication skills. Able to explain technical designs/questions to stakeholders, developers, security, etc.
* Ownership mindset. You care about platform reliability and user experience
* Willingness to learn and adopt new tooling / best practices



  
 



**What Will Make You Stand Out** 




  




* Experience in a SaaS\-based product company.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Familiarity with containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes.
* ISTQB Advanced Level Test Automation Engineer or similar certification.



   
 



**What We Offer** 




  




* Opportunity to be an early/hands\-on member of a startup building enterprise SaaS infrastructure
* Exposure to end\-to\-end systems: cloud, security, performance, scalability
* A collaborative engineering culture with learning \& growth
* Flexible / hybrid environment (if applicable)
* Competitive compensation \& benefits



  
 



**How to Apply** 




 Interested candidates, please send your updated CV to
 **recruitment@findingpi.com** 
 with subject line:
 **Application: Senior Test Engineer, PaperLite** 
 .

title: Automation Engineer
description:

You will harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences.
   

  

 To be successful as an Automation Engineer, you should have experience with:\-
   

  

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field, with relevant experience in software development, automation, and/or DevOps.
* Experience in Developing and maintaining automation solutions using technologies such as ASP.Net, C\#, SQL/NoSQL and Python.
* Hands on experience in building and deploying applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and IIS on Windows.
* Manage and resolve automation tool issues via incident, problem, and change tickets, following ITIL processes.
* Experience with one of the cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS.
* Familiarity with logging and monitoring tools (e.g. ELK stack, Datadog, Splunk) and reporting/dashboarding tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Kibana, Grafana).
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.

 Some other highly valued skills may include:\-
   

  

  

* Experience in Developing and maintaining automation solutions using technologies such as PowerShell, ELK stack, Power Platforms, GitLab, Azure.
* Hands on experience in Implementing observability, monitoring, and reporting solutions with ELK stack, Tableau, Power BI, and related tools.

 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.

 To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.

title: Salesforce QA Automation Engineer
description:
**Job Overview** 

  
 




  





 We are not looking for someone who simply executes test cases or reports defects. We're looking for a
 **Salesforce QA professional who understands how the platform works, can challenge solutions from a quality perspective, automate intelligently, and take ownership of the end\-to\-end quality of Salesforce releases** 
 .
 
  
 




  





 If you've ever looked at a Salesforce feature and thought,
 *"I need to understand what happens behind the UI, how the data flows, what happens when the automation fails, and how we can prevent this from breaking again,"* 
 we'd love to hear from you.
 
  
 




  





 You'll be working across Salesforce functionality, automation, APIs, integrations, backend data, security, and CI/CD to help build a reliable enterprise Salesforce platform.
 
  
 




  





**About SolidCAM** 

  
 




  





 SolidCAM is a global software company with offices in more than 30 countries and customers in over 80 countries. We're investing heavily in our Salesforce platform as part of a global transformation spanning Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Operations, Experience Cloud, CPQ, and enterprise integrations.
 
  
 




  





 As our Salesforce platform continues to grow, quality engineering is becoming increasingly important. We're looking for someone who can help us build a
 **robust, scalable and automated testing approach** 
 rather than simply validate functionality at the end of a development cycle.
 
  
 




  





**What You'll Be Doing** 

  
 




  




* Own functional and automated testing across Salesforce applications and business processes.
* Design comprehensive test scenarios, test cases, test data and regression suites.
* Test Salesforce objects, fields, relationships, Lightning UI, Flows, validation rules, approvals and business automation.
* Develop and maintain automated tests using
 **Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, WebdriverIO or equivalent frameworks** 
 .
* Build reusable automation components, frameworks, page/object models, assertions and reporting.
* Validate Salesforce backend data using
 **SOQL** 
 and Salesforce tools.
* Perform REST/SOAP API testing using Postman, REST Assured or equivalent tools.
* Test Salesforce integrations with external systems, including request/response validation, error handling and integration outcomes.
* Support
 **SIT, UAT, regression, smoke and end\-to\-end testing** 
 .
* Investigate automation failures and determine whether the root cause is related to application functionality, automation code, test data, configuration, integration or environment.
* Validate Salesforce security scenarios involving Profiles, Permission Sets, Sharing and Field\-Level Security.
* Execute automated regression suites and analyse logs, screenshots, reports and test results.
* Integrate automated testing into
 **CI/CD pipelines** 
 and work with Git/source control.
* Manage defects through their complete lifecycle using Jira, Azure DevOps or similar tools.
* Work closely with Salesforce developers, administrators, architects, business analysts and business stakeholders.
* Contribute to quality standards, test strategy, automation practices and continuous improvement.
* Support release validation and production defect analysis.
* Help identify opportunities to increase test automation coverage and reduce regression effort.



  





**What We're Looking For** 

  
 




  




* **4–5 years of QA/testing experience** 
 , with significant hands\-on Salesforce testing experience.
* Strong practical knowledge of Salesforce application and configuration testing.
* Hands\-on experience with
 **Salesforce functional and automation testing** 
 .
* Strong experience with test scenarios, test cases, test data, execution evidence and regression testing.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one automation framework such as
 **Selenium, Playwright, Cypress or WebdriverIO** 
 .
* Working knowledge of
 **Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python or another automation programming language** 
 .
* Ability to write and use
 **SOQL** 
 for Salesforce data validation.
* Experience testing Salesforce Flows, validation rules, approvals and record\-triggered automation.
* Experience with
 **REST/SOAP API testing** 
 and integration testing.
* Experience supporting SIT, UAT, regression, smoke and end\-to\-end testing.
* Understanding of Salesforce security, including Profiles, Permission Sets, Sharing and FLS.
* Experience with Git and CI/CD platforms such as
 **Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab or Azure DevOps** 
 .
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical issues clearly.



  





**You'll Thrive Here If You...** 

  
 




  




* Don't just report a defect — you investigate
 **why it happened** 
 .
* Enjoy understanding complex Salesforce business processes.
* Like testing beyond the UI and validating what is happening in the backend.
* Think about negative scenarios, edge cases and failure conditions.
* Enjoy building automation rather than repeatedly executing manual regression tests.
* Can distinguish between an application defect, automation defect, data issue, integration issue and environment problem.
* Take ownership of quality instead of treating QA as the final step in development.
* Like improving existing test frameworks and processes.
* Can explain technical problems in simple business language.
* Enjoy working closely with developers and challenging solutions constructively.
* Want to help establish long\-term Salesforce quality and automation standards.



  





**Good to Have** 

  
 




  




* Salesforce Administrator or Platform App Builder certification.
* Salesforce Platform Foundations certification.
* Experience with
 **Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud**
* Strong Selenium WebDriver, Playwright or Cypress framework development experience.
* API automation using REST Assured or equivalent.
* Experience with Salesforce DX, Salesforce CLI and sandbox/scratch environments.
* Experience with performance, load or security testing.
* Experience testing Salesforce Files, ContentDocument, ContentVersion and ContentDocumentLink.
* Experience testing asynchronous Salesforce processing, scheduled jobs and integration retry/error handling.
* Experience validating large data volumes and data migrations.
* Experience creating automation dashboards, reports and quality metrics.
* ISTQB or other recognized QA certification.



  





**Contract or Full\-Time** 

  
 




  





 We're open to both experienced consultants and candidates looking for a permanent opportunity.
 
  
 




  





 Many great long\-term hires begin by working together on a consulting basis. If there's a strong mutual fit, we're happy to discuss a permanent QA leadership or senior engineering opportunity.
 
  
 




  





 We're far more interested in
 **your thinking, ownership, technical depth and problem\-solving approach** 
 than simply the tools listed on your CV.

title: Senior SDET
description:
At Securonix, we’re on a mission to secure the world by staying ahead of cyber threats and reinforcing all layers of our platform with AI capabilities. Our Securonix Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with the first and only AI\-reinforced solution built with a cybersecurity mesh architecture on a highly scalable data cloud. Enhanced by Securonix EON’s AI capabilities, our innovative cloud\-native solution delivers a seamless CyberOps experience, empowering organizations to scale their security operations and keep pace with evolving threats.
   

  

 Recognized as a five\-time Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM and highly rated on Gartner Peer Insights, our award\-winning Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with 365 days of “hot” data for rapid search and investigation, threat content\-as\-a\-service, proactive defense through continuous peer and partner collaboration, and a fully integrated Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response (TDIR) experience—all within a single platform. Built on a cloud\-native architecture, the platform leverages the Snowflake Data Cloud for unparalleled scalability and performance.
   

  

 Securonix is proud to be a cybersecurity unicorn and to be featured in CRN’s 2024 Security 100 list. Backed by Vista Equity Partners, one of the largest private equity firms, with over $100 billion in assets under management, we have a unique advantage in driving innovation and growth. With a global footprint, we serve more than 1,000 customers worldwide, including 10% of the Fortune 100\. Our network of 150\+ partners and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) enables us to deliver unmatched security solutions on a global scale.
   

  

 At Securonix, we are driven by our core values and place our people at the heart of everything we do:
   

  

* Winning as One Team: We work together with universal respect to achieve aligned outcomes.
* Customer\-Driven Innovation: We innovate to stay ahead of the market and create value for our customers.
* Agility in Action: We embrace change and remain unified in our purpose and objectives.


 We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to drive quality engineering and automation across Securonix products, including SIEM, ThreatQ (Threat Intelligence Platform/TIP), and associated cloud, microservices, data, and security capabilities.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Senior SDET, you will design and build scalable automation solutions across API, UI, backend, integration, and end\-to\-end workflows. The ideal candidate will have strong programming skills in Python, hands\-on experience with Pytest and Playwright, and a solid understanding of API and microservices testing. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and QA teams to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks using Python and Pytest.
* Build and maintain modern UI and end\-to\-end automation using Playwright.
* Develop automated test suites for API, UI, backend, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Drive an API\-first automation strategy for microservices and platform capabilities.
* Validate REST APIs, service\-to\-service integrations, authentication, data contracts, error handling, and distributed workflows.
* Validate data\-processing pipelines and data integrity using Python, SQL, and API\-based validation.
* Test complex workflows across Securonix products, including SIEM and ThreatQ/TIP.
* Develop reusable automation libraries, utilities, fixtures, test\-data management, and reporting capabilities.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and enable continuous testing.
* Analyze automation failures, application logs, API responses, and backend data to perform root\-cause analysis.
* Participate in design and architecture discussions to improve testability, observability, reliability, and product quality.
* Identify regression risks and ensure appropriate automated coverage for new features and production defect fixes.
* Mentor QA/SDET engineers on automation design, coding standards, debugging, and testing best practices.
* Explore AI\-assisted testing and automation to improve test coverage, productivity, and defect detection.


**Required Technical Skills**
* 5–8 years of experience in Quality Engineering, Test Automation, or SDET roles.
* Strong programming experience in Python.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Pytest, including fixtures, parametrization, reusable libraries, and framework design.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Playwright for UI and end\-to\-end automation.
* Strong experience in REST API automation and testing.
* Experience designing or contributing to scalable automation frameworks—not only individual test scripts.
* Strong understanding of microservices and distributed architectures.
* Experience with SQL and backend/data validation.
* Experience testing complex integration and end\-to\-end workflows.
* Experience integrating automation with CI/CD systems such as Jenkins, Harness, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
* Good understanding of Git, Linux/Unix, debugging, logging, and defect\-management tools such as JIRA.
* Strong understanding of software\-testing principles, test\-design techniques, regression strategies, and Agile development practices.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Strong problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and debugging skills.
* Ability to take end\-to\-end ownership of quality for a feature or product area.
* Ability to understand complex product architectures and identify appropriate testing strategies.
* Strong collaboration skills for working with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and other QA/SDET teams.
* Passion for automation, cybersecurity, AI, and modern quality engineering.


 Why Join Securonix?
   

  

 Work at the intersection of cybersecurity, AI, automation, cloud, and large\-scale data platforms while building quality\-engineering solutions for products used by global enterprises. This role provides significant ownership of automation strategy and an opportunity to influence how quality is engineered across Securonix product lines.
   

  

**Benefits**
 As a full\-time employee of Securonix, you will be eligible for the following benefits:
   

  

* Health insurance with a total sum insured of INR 7,50,000\.
* Coverage for self, spouse, two children, and dependent parents or parents\-in\-law.
* Personal accident insurance with a total sum insured of INR 10,00,000\.
* Term life insurance coverage equal to five times the employee’s fixed base pay.

title: Performance Engineer -  Performance Testing, JMeter, Load Runner, API Performance & Java/JVM
description:
**Scope**
* We provide 3PL customers with the integrated supply chain solution for planning, TMS, OMS \& WMS.
* The 3PL PSR team works closely with QA, Development, DevOps, DBA, Solution Architect and Infrastructure teams to ensure applications meet performance and scalability requirements.
* The role requires both hands\-on performance engineering and architectural understanding, ensuring scalable and future\-ready implementations.
* The individual will be responsible for designing, planning, and executing performance, load, stress, endurance, and scalability testing for enterprise applications.
* Also, the individual will be responsible for analysing application behaviour and identify performance bottlenecks across application, database, infrastructure, and network layers.


**Technical Environment**
* Performance Testing Tools: Jmeter
* API/Application: REST APIs, JSON/XML, HTTP/HTTPS, Web applications, Microservices, Postman
* Scripting \& Development: JavaScript, Groovy, Python, Shell scripting
* Databases: Oracle, MariaDb; SQL query analysis and database performance analysis
* Database Performance: Oracle AWR/ASH, execution plans, SQL tuning, database CPU/memory/I/O analysis
* Application \& JVM Monitoring: JVM, Garbage Collection (GC), Heap/Thread Dumps, JProfiler, Eclipse MAT or equivalent tools
* Infrastructure \& Monitoring: Linux, Kubernetes, Docker, OCI/Azure, CPU/Memory/Disk/Network monitoring, Grafana, OEM
* DevOps/Agile: Git, Jenkins
* Cloud: OCI/Azure integrations
* Others: RDP/SSH, Linux command\-line utilities, log analysis, performance profiling, capacity planning, and production performance monitoring.


**What You’ll Do**
* Design and execute performance, load, stress, endurance, and scalability tests for enterprise applications.
* Develop and maintain JMeter/API performance test scripts, workload models, test data, and execution scenarios.
* Analyse application performance across application, database, JVM, infrastructure, and network layers.
* Monitor system behaviour during load tests and identify CPU, memory, database, JVM, I/O, and response\-time bottlenecks.
* Perform root\-cause analysis of performance issues using application logs, monitoring tools, AWR/ASH reports, thread dumps, heap dumps, and GC logs.
* Work closely with Developers, QA, DBAs, DevOps, and Infrastructure teams to troubleshoot and resolve performance issues.
* Analyse test results and prepare performance reports, dashboards, and recommendations for stakeholders.
* Support capacity planning, scalability assessment, and production\-readiness reviews.
* Identify opportunities to automate performance testing, monitoring, and reporting to improve efficiency and repeatability.
* Participate in release planning and provide performance assessment and recommendations for production deployment.
* Communicate performance findings, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.
* 1\-3 years of experience in Performance Testing / Performance Engineering.
* Strong hands\-on experience with JMeter and performance test scripting.
* Good understanding of load, stress, endurance, scalability, and volume testing.
* Strong experience in API performance testing using REST/HTTP, JSON/XML, and Postman.
* Good understanding of Java/JVM, including heap, threads, GC, and JVM tuning.
* Experience with JProfiler, Eclipse MAT, thread/heap dumps, and GC logs.
* Experience with Linux/Unix, shell scripting, and application/log analysis.
* Good knowledge of SQL and database performance, preferably Oracle, including AWR/ASH and execution plan analysis on OEM.
* Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, InfluxDB, or equivalent monitoring tools.
* Understanding of Kubernetes/containerized environments and exposure to OCI/Azure is preferred.
* Strong performance troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple performance testing activities within timelines.


**Our Values**
 If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Sr. Test Engineer - Master Data Management (MDM) Job
description:
YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.
   

  

 At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting\-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.
   

  

**We are looking forward to hire Master Data Management (MDM) Professionals in the following areas :**
**Experience Level 4\+ Years**
**Job Title: MDM Quality Engineer / Test Engineer –**
**Role Overview**
 We're looking for a detail\-oriented Quality Engineer with experience in Master Data Management testing to ensure the reliability, accuracy, and performance of our MDM platform. You'll be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies across data models, integrations, match \& merge rules, workflows, and data quality processes — ensuring that master data is accurate, consistent, and fit for business use.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and execute test strategies and test plans for MDM implementations, including unit, functional, integration, regression, and performance testing.
* Validate Reltio data models, entity configurations, relationships, attributes, and reference data for accuracy and completeness.
* Test match \& merge rules, survivorship logic, and deduplication processes to ensure golden record quality meets business expectations.
* Validate integration pipelines (batch and real\-time) between Reltio and source/target systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes, APIs) for data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
* Perform data quality testing — profiling, validation, and reconciliation — across source systems and the Reltio MDM hub.
* Test Reltio workflows, business rules, stewardship processes, and exception handling scenarios.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts for regression and data validation testing using tools such as Python, SQL, or Selenium.
* Perform API testing of Reltio REST APIs using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or similar.
* Conduct performance and load testing on Reltio integrations and platform configurations.
* Log, track, and manage defects through the full lifecycle using JIRA or similar tools, working closely with developers to ensure timely resolution.
* Collaborate with business analysts, data stewards, and developers to understand requirements and define acceptance criteria.
* Validate data migration activities — pre\-migration, mid\-migration, and post\-migration — ensuring data integrity and completeness.
* Participate in UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and support business stakeholders during testing cycles.
* Develop and maintain test documentation including test cases, test scripts, test data, and test summary reports.
* Contribute to the definition and enforcement of QA best practices within MDM projects.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 3\+ years of experience in software or data quality engineering, with at least 1–2 years of exposure to MDM platforms (Reltio preferred, or Informatica MDM, Semarchy, SAP MDG, Stibo STEP, or similar).
* Hands\-on understanding of Reltio MDM concepts — entities, relationships, match \& merge, survivorship, hierarchies, and workflows — sufficient to design meaningful test cases.
* Strong SQL skills for data validation, reconciliation, and querying across relational/cloud databases.
* Experience testing REST APIs using Postman, REST Assured, or similar API testing tools.
* Experience with test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar).
* Familiarity with ETL/integration testing (validating data pipelines, transformation logic, and data flow accuracy).
* Experience with data quality testing concepts — completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to define test scenarios from complex business and data requirements.
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working within sprint\-based delivery teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with test automation frameworks (Selenium, PyTest, or similar) and scripting in Python or Groovy.
* Exposure to performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, or similar) for MDM and integration pipelines.
* Reltio platform certification or formal training is a plus.
* Experience testing Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or GCP data platforms integrated with Reltio.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.) for automated testing workflows.
* Experience with data migration testing in large\-scale MDM implementation projects.
* Knowledge of data privacy/compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA) and their impact on data quality and testing requirements.
* Experience in industries such as Manufacturing, life sciences, healthcare, retail, or financial services.


**Key Competencies**
* Meticulous attention to detail and strong data analytical mindset.

description:
**Roboyo AI is a category shaper in Applied AI and Agentic Automation.**

 We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production\-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services.
 

  
 





 Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human\-in\-the\-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate.
 

  
 





 We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs.
 

  
 




  
 







**About the role** 




 We're looking for a
 **Senior Automation Engineer** 
 to own the technical delivery of UiPath automation workstreams end\-to\-end — from design and development through testing and deployment — working with international clients across a distributed, global delivery environment.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, develop, and deploy complex, scalable Intelligent Automation solutions using advanced UiPath capabilities, integrating with various APIs, databases, and enterprise systems.

* Actively participate in the CI/CD pipeline, writing and executing automated unit and integration tests to ensure flawless deployments and mitigate production risks.
* Take the lead on diagnosing and resolving complex technical defects, optimising performance bottlenecks, and stabilizing processes before handoff to support teams.

**Must Have Qualifications** 



* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in Intelligent Automation software engineering, including practical experience with
 **UiPath IXP (Intelligent Xtraction and Processing)** 
 — converting unstructured and semi\-structured data such as emails, contracts, and invoices into structured data for automation
* Strong proficiency with UiPath Studio, Orchestrator, and REFramework
* UiPath Advanced RPA Developer certification
* **Solid experience with AI Center, Action Center and proven expertise in building Agentic AI solutions**
* Exposure to coded agents and agent builder of UiPath
* Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to reverse\-engineer legacy processes and design elegant, efficient modern architectures.
* Strong ability to articulate technical challenges and solutions clearly to both technical peers and project management.



**Nice to have qualifications** 



* Exposure to consulting environments or client\-facing roles
* Python coding skills or willingness to grow technical capabilities
* Interest in upskilling in related technologies such as process mining (e.g., Celonis, UiPath Process Mining), low\-code platforms (e.g., Power Apps), conversational AI (e.g., Cognigy, Druid), or test automation (UiPath Test Suite)
