description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Functional Tester – Quality Engineering**
**Location:** 
 Bangalore/Pune
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Functional Test Lead** 
 who is detail\-oriented, analytical, and passionate about quality assurance. This role focuses on validating business functionality across Trade Lifecyle platform and technologies, ensuring that software meets user expectations and business requirements.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business and functional requirements.
* Translate requirements into comprehensive test scenarios and test cases.
* Independently lead requirement clarification sessions and identify data dependencies.
* Execute functional, regression, and integration testing across web, API, and backend systems.
* Maintain traceability between requirements, test cases, and defects.
* Participate in test strategy and planning for new features and enhancements.
* Identify and report defects, track resolution, and validate fixes.
* Contribute to end\-to\-end testing efforts in Agile environments.
* Support API/UI testing, security testing, and performance validation as needed.
* Provide feedback on usability and user experience from a testing perspective.
* Review product changes throughout the development lifecycle.
* Prepare and maintain test documentation and reports.
* Collaborate with developers and product teams to ensure quality delivery.


**Requirements**
* A bachelor's degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* 10\+ years of SDET experience, with exposure to Fund Accounting or capital markets.
* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies (manual and automated).
* Experience with tools like Jira, Azure Boards, Postman, SoapUI, and test management platforms.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, messaging systems (e.g., Solace, MQ, Kafka), and databases (SQL/NoSQL).
* Exposure to automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cucumber) is a plus but not mandatory.
* Experience working in Agile environments with TDD/BDD practices.
* Excellent communication, time management, and organizational skills.
* Ability to identify risks and edge cases in business workflows.


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability.  **React**

 **React Native** 
 mobile features with
 **SQLite** 
 offline support,
 **Node.js** 
 RESTful API endpoints, and
 **Microsoft SQL Server** 
 database interactions. The Application Developer will assist with integration testing, participate in code reviews, and support deployment activities under the direction of senior team members. This role requires use of
 **AWS AI services** 
 (Transcribe, Textract, Bedrock),
 **Snowflake** 
 data integration, and
 **Microsoft Entra** 
 authentication flows (migrating from Okta). This position is based at Vertiv’s India office.

* React Frontend Development \& Customization: Develop and customize frontend React components and TypeScript for the Site Scope web portal; implement feature enhancements and bug fixes to meet business requirements for sales and technical team workflows under the direction of the Tech Lead.

* Backend API Development \& Integration Support: Develop and maintain Node.js RESTful API endpoints; work with Sequelize ORM for SQL Server database operations; assist with troubleshooting JWT authentication flows, SMTP email notifications, and Snowflake data connectivity.

* Deployment \& CI/CD Support: Support deployment activities using on\-premises GitLab CI/CD pipelines; assist with web application builds, Android deployments via internal testing tracks, and iOS builds using Xcode on Mac VM; follow established version control processes and support TestFlight distributions for non\-production testing.

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field; equivalent practical experience considered.

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency with TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern web development fundamentals including responsive, mobile\-friendly design.
* Basic understanding of REST APIs and HTTP communication; familiarity with Axios or equivalent HTTP clients and API testing tools (Postman).

* Basic familiarity with Linux/Windows server environments and command\-line operations.

title: Electronic Systems Technical Specialist - Software
description:
**Job Summary**
 This applied technology position creates software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins’ products. People in these positions have involvement in identification and understanding of stakeholder requirements and developing specifications, and responsibility for design, implementation, testing and/or release of software that controls the operation of Cummins’ products in a variety of customer applications.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Investigates product software problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution, and documents results. Applies and improves the improvement of product software development processes and tools. Processes include coding, compiling and test. Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Obtains input and negotiates with product and software development teams and delivers verified software features, components, builds to product teams. Uses systems knowledge and expertise to make decisions in the areas of software requirements, architecture, design, and test that impact the quality and performance of software builds, product lines (platforms) and management of cross\-BU integration and coordination. Responsible for review of less\-experienced developers/testers’ work to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient designs. Responsibile for interacting and collaborating with cross\-functional teams. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across function(s) within a global business unit or managing improvement across business units. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.
   

  

**Competencies**
 Product Failure Mode Avoidance \- Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.
   

  

 Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis \- Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub\-system and/or component level requirements.
   

  

 Product Platform Planning and Architecting \- Creates and develops a holistic product platform including key architectural feature and function variants needed to align with market level product plans of future target markets; generates alternative architectures traceable to the requirements and performs trade\-off analysis in collaboration with life\-cycle stakeholders to ensure a balanced and optimum platform; communicates and maintains traceable information and plans executed by product development teams.
   

  

 Product Software Design and Construction \- Constructs product software using industry best practices and robust software engineering principles; verifies software updates to ensure quality products.
   

  

 Product Verification and Validation Management \- Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.
   

  

 System Requirements Engineering \- Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
   

  

 Systems Thinking \- Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.
   

  

 Builds networks \- Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.
   

  

 Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
   

  

 Decision quality \- Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
   

  

 Drives results \- Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
   

  

 Manages complexity \- Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
   

  

 Resourcefulness \- Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
   

  

**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
 College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.
   

  

 Post\-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.
   

  

 This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
   

  

**Experience**
 Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred
   

  

**Resposibilities**
* Develop embedded fuel systems controls software per requirements
* Follow all Cummins internal software processes while developing embedded fuel system controls software
* Modify existing software implementation to support the software change
* Verify and document evidence of the software change functioning correctly
* Solve the software related problems by determining the root cause
* Generate a solution to fix the problem identified and verify on test bench
* Highlight software integration changes to peers in a timely manner
* Support global software team to deliver software for global engine programs
* Align with global software development functional excellence practices
* The work will include development in both ‘C’ code as well as in Simulink models.Other tools used for development will include the use of a Cummins proprietary data dictionary and build tool, configuration management tools as well as test tools (oscilloscopes, frequency generators, debuggers, etc.…)


**Skills – Functional/Technical**
* MTech or BTech Electrical Engineering or computer science with embedded controls development focus preferred
* 7 to 9 years industry experience or equivalent academic experience in development of automotive controls software
* Experience with MATLAB and Simulink for model\-based development.
* Experience with programming in C or other imperative and procedural languages.
* Understanding of diesel engines, mechanical systems, especially fuel systems and air handling systems is a plus
* Good communication and presentation skills required for documenting software design, test results and observations
* Experience or familiarity with microprocessor based embedded control system development
* Understanding of AUTOSAR

title: AI Architect
description:
**Job Description**
**Shape ZenseAI.QI and ZenseAI.AssureAI**
* Architect and evolve the platform suite across both engines: the 18\-agent ZenseAI.QI stack (DeepSpeci, CaseGeni, Auto\-PlayPilot, DataGeni, Secure\-Xi, Perf\-Xi, Insights360, RIA and Accessibility Intelligence) and the four\-pillar ZenseAI.AssureAI framework (Data Quality, Model Evaluation, Trustworthiness, and Scalability \& Security).
* Design and refine the archetype\-specific assurance lifecycles for Classical ML, Generative AI and Agentic AI, including the signature eight\-axis agentic trajectory scorecard graded on every run.
* Keep the platforms LLM\-agnostic and deployable on any client stack — on\-prem, cloud or hybrid — as model\-mixing and constant provider churn become the market norm.
* Own technical roadmap decisions for accelerators such as the Agentic Foundry (a 25\-blueprint reference matrix) and the curated, swap\-ready tooling ecosystem around each archetype.


**Lead Evaluation\-Driven Development**
* Build and govern eval suites — ground\-truth Q\&A sets, LLM\-as\-judge rubrics, frozen baselines — that gate every release rather than validate it after the fact.
* Own trajectory grading, red/purple/blue\-team probes and safety attestations for agentic and generative systems, and drift monitoring and fairness audits for classical ML.
* Translate evaluation results into release decisions: eval\-threshold gates, red\-team severity floors, canary and shadow deployments, and rollback rehearsals.
* Bring evaluation\-driven development practice into client engagements — showing, not just telling, how a live harness beats a one\-time audit.


**Own Presales and Client Proposals**
* Respond to RFPs, RFIs and client proposals across both engines, translating client requirements into a defensible solution architecture and commercial structure.
* Architect engagements across the full ladder — AI QA Assessment, AI QA Transformation, Managed AI QA — and fast\-starts such as the LLM Health Check, Agent Stress Test and Compliance Sprint.
* Build estimates, staffing plans and technical win themes that hold up under client and internal scrutiny, across client\-managed, risk\-reward and Zensar\-managed commercial models.


**Present and Articulate Value to Clients**
* Present the ZenseAI.QI and ZenseAI.AssureAI value proposition directly to client stakeholders — from QA Directors and Heads of AI/ML Engineering to CTOs, Chief Risk Officers and Chief AI Officers — adapting the narrative to each audience.
* Lead client workshops and technical walkthroughs, including guiding a CIO through the Agentic Foundry in a single session.
* Build and deliver executive trust scorecards and portfolio risk heat maps that make the assurance story board\-ready.


**Represent Zensar in Client Captives for Sales**
* Present live in client captive sessions and sales pursuits as the senior technical voice for Quality Intelligence, alongside account and sales leadership.
* Run and narrate proof\-of\-concept demonstrations that turn a client's stated risk into a small, credible proof — the practice's proof\-first approach to closing.
* Represent the practice at partner and industry forums as the practice's thought leadership and pipeline develop.


**Build Practice IP and Mentor the Next Generation**
* Contribute reusable accelerators, reference architectures and industry packs across BFSI, TMT, and Manufacturing \& Retail back into the practice's IP base.
* Mentor and help build out the practice's emerging AI\-specialist roles — Prompt Engineer, LLM\-Eval Engineer, Agent Architect, Trajectory Eval Engineer, Knowledge/RAG Engineer, AI Security Analyst and Adversarial Red/Blue Team Lead.
* Support GenAI and AI\-enablement training for QI associates across the practice.


**Responsibilities**
**Must\-Have**
* Approximately 17–21 years of overall technology experience, including a substantial, hands\-on foundation in Quality Engineering / Test Engineering — automation architecture, test strategy and the full software testing lifecycle — not AI experimentation layered on top of a thin QE background.
* Working architectural knowledge of agentic AI systems: multi\-agent orchestration, tool use, memory, and the operational risks specific to agents — unauthorised tool calls, trajectory drift, memory leakage across accounts.
* Direct experience with evaluation\-driven development: building or governing eval suites, LLM\-as\-judge frameworks, ground\-truth datasets, frozen baselines and red\-teaming / adversarial testing for generative or agentic systems.
* Strong client\-interfacing capability: comfortable owning technical content in an RFP response, presenting to CXO\-level stakeholders, and holding the room in a live client or sales captive setting.
* Ability to talk convincingly across both deterministic QE and probabilistic AI assurance — the “one estate” narrative is the core sell, and the architect has to embody it, not just recite it.
* Familiarity with the regulatory and standards backdrop shaping AI assurance conversations: EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001\.


**Qualifications**
* Approximately 17–21 years of overall technology experience, including a substantial, hands\-on foundation in Quality Engineering / Test Engineering — automation architecture, test strategy and the full software testing lifecycle — not AI experimentation layered on top of a thin QE background.

* Familiarity with the regulatory and standards backdrop shaping AI assurance conversations: EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001\.

 Pune, IN
   

  

 YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.
   

  

 At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting\-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.
   

  

**We are looking forward to hire Master Data Management (MDM) Professionals in the following areas :**
**Experience Level 4\+ Years**
**Job Title: MDM Quality Engineer / Test Engineer –**
****Role Overview****
 We're looking for a detail\-oriented Quality Engineer with experience in Master Data Management testing to ensure the reliability, accuracy, and performance of our MDM platform. You'll be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies across data models, integrations, match \& merge rules, workflows, and data quality processes — ensuring that master data is accurate, consistent, and fit for business use.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Design, develop, and execute test strategies and test plans for MDM implementations, including unit, functional, integration, regression, and performance testing.
* Validate Reltio data models, entity configurations, relationships, attributes, and reference data for accuracy and completeness.
* Test match \& merge rules, survivorship logic, and deduplication processes to ensure golden record quality meets business expectations.
* Validate integration pipelines (batch and real\-time) between Reltio and source/target systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes, APIs) for data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
* Perform data quality testing — profiling, validation, and reconciliation — across source systems and the Reltio MDM hub.
* Test Reltio workflows, business rules, stewardship processes, and exception handling scenarios.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts for regression and data validation testing using tools such as Python, SQL, or Selenium.
* Perform API testing of Reltio REST APIs using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or similar.
* Conduct performance and load testing on Reltio integrations and platform configurations.
* Log, track, and manage defects through the full lifecycle using JIRA or similar tools, working closely with developers to ensure timely resolution.
* Collaborate with business analysts, data stewards, and developers to understand requirements and define acceptance criteria.
* Validate data migration activities — pre\-migration, mid\-migration, and post\-migration — ensuring data integrity and completeness.
* Participate in UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and support business stakeholders during testing cycles.
* Develop and maintain test documentation including test cases, test scripts, test data, and test summary reports.
* Contribute to the definition and enforcement of QA best practices within MDM projects.


****Required Skills \& Experience****
* 3\+ years of experience in software or data quality engineering, with at least 1–2 years of exposure to MDM platforms (Reltio preferred, or Informatica MDM, Semarchy, SAP MDG, Stibo STEP, or similar).
* Hands\-on understanding of Reltio MDM concepts — entities, relationships, match \& merge, survivorship, hierarchies, and workflows — sufficient to design meaningful test cases.
* Strong SQL skills for data validation, reconciliation, and querying across relational/cloud databases.
* Experience testing REST APIs using Postman, REST Assured, or similar API testing tools.
* Experience with test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar).
* Familiarity with ETL/integration testing (validating data pipelines, transformation logic, and data flow accuracy).
* Experience with data quality testing concepts — completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to define test scenarios from complex business and data requirements.
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working within sprint\-based delivery teams.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Experience with test automation frameworks (Selenium, PyTest, or similar) and scripting in Python or Groovy.
* Exposure to performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, or similar) for MDM and integration pipelines.
* Reltio platform certification or formal training is a plus.
* Experience testing Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or GCP data platforms integrated with Reltio.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.) for automated testing workflows.
* Experience with data migration testing in large\-scale MDM implementation projects.
* Knowledge of data privacy/compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA) and their impact on data quality and testing requirements.
* Experience in industries such as Manufacturing, life sciences, healthcare, retail, or financial services.


**Key Competencies**
* Meticulous attention to detail and strong data analytical mindset.
* Ability to understand complex data relationships and identify edge cases in match/merge scenarios.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills to work across data engineering, business, and architecture teams.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple test deliverables across concurrent project tracks.
* Proactive in identifying risks, raising issues early, and proposing pragmatic testing solutions.


 At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career\-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale.

 The role requires strong understanding of requirements management, SDLC practices, systems integration, web services, troubleshooting, and workflow management. The candidate should be a key contributor who can informally coach others and help teams deliver reliable, maintainable solutions.
   

  

 Role

* Design and maintain integration tests for systems, services, APIs, data flows, interfaces, and dependencies.
* Apply agile work management practices to plan, prioritize, and manage work effectively in iterative delivery environments.
* Partner with product owners, developers, and delivery teams to clarify requirements, manage changes, identify risks, and ensure testability.
* Lead UI, API, backend, integration, and performance automation using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Gatling, and BlazeMeter.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues across systems, applications, services, integrations, environments, and networks.
* Analyze workflows, remove bottlenecks, streamline procedures, monitor progress, and adapt processes to improve delivery.
* Communicate status, risks, dependencies, and quality insights clearly to stakeholders and leadership while promoting continuous improvement.

 The ideal candidate for this position should have:
   

  

* Strong experience in quality engineering, test strategy, planning, automation, QA, and validation across complex technology programs.
* Hands\-on experience with UI, API, backend, and integration automation tools such as Playwright, Cypress, and API automation frameworks.

 The Globalization Experience Team is searching for an Internationalization Software Engineer responsible for creating, enhancing, and maintaining robust software and tooling so SAS products work correctly for global users across languages, locales, and character sets. This role focuses on building and integrating foundational internationalization capabilities—Unicode correctness, locale‑sensitive formatting and sorting, and string externalization/resource management—while partnering with product teams to embed best practices early in the software development cycle. You’ll also use AI\-assisted techniques (when appropriate) to accelerate analysis, automation, and documentation, helping teams deliver global\-ready software efficiently and consistently.
   

  

**As An Internationalization AI Software Developer, You Will**
* Design, develop, and maintain software, libraries, and tooling that enable product teams to efficiently build high‑quality, global‑ready software in compliance with SAS Internationalization guidelines and standards.
* Work effectively in mature and legacy code to resolve customer\-impacting defects, coordinating with support and product teams to deliver patch updates for high\-priority fixes with strong testing and regression awareness to protect production behavior
* Partner closely with cross‑functional stakeholders—including product development teams, product managers, project managers, support engineers, and testers—to integrate internationalization best practices early and throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Collaborate with internationalization testers to guide testing strategies, investigate defects, and drive engineering improvements that result in high‑quality, globally usable product deliverables.
* Use AI\-assisted tools responsibly as part of day‑to‑day engineering (e.g., accelerating code review and refactoring suggestions, log/defect triage, test generation, and documentation) while ensuring correctness, traceability, and alignment with SAS development standards.


**Required Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience as a software developer, with hands‑on experience applying internationalization best practices and working with industry‑standard libraries such as ICU and CLDR.
* Experience using modern developer productivity tools (including AI\-assisted coding and review tools) to improve delivery speed and quality, with an understanding of validation practices (tests, reviews, and responsible use).
* Proficiency in one or more of the following programming languages: Go, Python, and C, with the ability to read, understand, and contribute to production codebases.
* Working proficiency in shell scripting (e.g., Bash or similar) to support automation, tooling, or development workflows.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross‑functional teams including developers, testers, and product stakeholders.
* Hands‑on experience using GitHub in a team environment, including branching strategies, pull requests, and code review processes.
* Experience using Jira and Confluence as part of an Agile development process, including issue tracking, planning, and documentation.
* Ability to adjust working hours to accommodate a variety of time zones
* You’re curious, passionate, authentic and accountable. These are our values and influence everything we do.


**Additional Competencies, Knowledge And Skills**
* Experience with SAS programming or familiarity with SAS language, tools, or development environments.
* Experience with TypeScript and Java Script a plus.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, including build, test, or deployment automation.
* Proficiency in additional spoken language.

title: IT Quality Senior Analyst - Assistant Vice President
description:
Citi is looking for a Senior IT Quality Analyst to lead quality assurance across complex trading platform environments, ensuring that software meets the highest standards before reaching production. In this role, you will own UAT processes, drive test automation strategy, and serve as a senior quality voice across cross\-functional technology teams. Your work will directly influence the reliability and integrity of systems that support Futures and Options trading on a global scale.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead User Acceptance Testing initiatives for trading platform products, translating complex business requirements into structured test strategies and ensuring seamless rollout to production.
* Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts and scenarios using Java and Cucumber (BDD), improving test coverage and reducing time\-to\-market for critical system releases.
* Monitor software products and development processes for conformance to quality standards, identify risks and implement corrective actions to maintain compliance across the software development lifecycle.
* Conduct root cause analyses on quality failures, document findings with precision, and independently recommend process improvements that elevate team\-wide quality outcomes.
* Analyze complex trade data — including order types and execution flows — to validate system behavior and ensure alignment with FIX protocol and electronic trading regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate test strategy development and execution across project teams, global stakeholders, and third\-party vendors, ensuring consistent delivery against timelines and quality benchmarks.
* Gather, maintain, and report on quality metrics to provide leadership and project teams with clear visibility into testing progress, defect trends, and risk posture.
* Mentor and coach junior quality analysts, sharing technical expertise and contributing to the team's overall development.


**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
* 10 or more years of experience in an IT Quality or software quality assurance role, with demonstrated ownership across the full testing lifecycle.
* Hands\-on experience testing trading platforms, with a solid understanding of Futures and Options products, order types, and electronic trading processes.
* Proficiency in test automation using Java and Behavior\-Driven Development frameworks, specifically Cucumber, with the ability to write, modify, and execute complex automated test scripts.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, container environments (ECS), and version control using GitHub, enabling integration of quality practices into modern delivery workflows.
* Good understanding of the FIX protocol, regulatory obligations for electronic trading, and the ability to validate system behavior against these standards.
* Ability to write complex queries and work with reporting tools to analyses large volumes of trade and system data effectively.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate across project teams, vendors, and global counterparts to align on quality outcomes.


**Beneficial Skills \& Qualifications**
* Project management experience, with the ability to plan, track, and communicate quality workstreams within fast\-paced, time\-sensitive delivery programmes.
* Experience defining and documenting business requirements, bridging the gap between technology teams and business stakeholders to ensure test coverage reflects real\-world use cases.
* Prior involvement in vendor management, including coordinating quality activities and testing accountability across third\-party technology providers.


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

title: IDP Platform Engineer
description:
**Role Purpose** 




  





 Your job is developer enablement, and it is hands\-on: you own the integration and automation layer of an enterprise internal developer platform built on Port.io. You will write the services and connectors that pull the platform's data together, build the workflows behind every self\-service action using GitHub Actions and Temporal, maintain the reusable pipeline templates and embedded quality gates other teams consume, and operate the containerised runtime it all runs on.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* **Integration development:** 
 Write the integration services and custom connectors that connect the platform to ServiceNow (approvals, CMDB), identity, observability, cloud platforms and the delivery toolchain, using TypeScript or Node.js and Python with the Ocean framework.
* **Catalogue data:** 
 Build and maintain the ingestion that keeps the software catalogue accurate and current across source control, cloud platforms and enterprise systems.
* **Workflow orchestration:** 
 Build the automation behind self\-service actions, using GitHub Actions for standard workflows and Temporal for durable orchestrations.
* **Pipeline products:** 
 Build reusable, versioned CI/CD pipeline templates consumed as golden paths.
* **Developer enablement:** 
 Unblock developers on pipelines, environments, tooling and automation, and make the supported approach the simplest one to follow.
* **Integration runtime:** 
 Deploy and operate the self\-hosted integration workloads, such as Ocean\-based connectors and event listeners, as containerised services on Kubernetes.
* **Performance testing capability:** 
 Operate and improve the k6 framework, covering its GitHub workflow integration, Kubernetes execution model and Grafana and InfluxDB visibility, and onboard engineering teams to it.
* **Quality gates:** 
 Integrate security scanning (Wiz, Checkov, OPA), testing and cost tooling so the gates apply by default.



  





**Essential** 




  




* **CI/CD depth:** 
 6\+ years in DevOps or platform engineering with advanced GitHub Actions experience, covering reusable workflows, composite actions, secrets and runner strategy. Equivalent platforms are fine if you are happy to standardise on Actions.
* **Kubernetes:** 
 Solid working Kubernetes
* **Scripting and APIs:** 
 Strong scripting in TypeScript, Node.js, Python or Go, and automation against REST APIs and webhooks.
* **Software engineering:** 
 Production coding ability, not just scripting: services and integrations written in TypeScript or Node.js and Python, with the testing, review and documentation discipline that implies.
* **API integration:** 
 Building and consuming REST APIs, webhooks and event\-driven integrations against enterprise systems, including authentication flows, rate limits and failure handling.
* **Enablement mindset:** 
 A track record of supporting and unblocking development teams, treating automation as a product with users.
* **Pipeline security:** 
 Building security into pipelines: secrets management, least\-privilege runners and service identities, and dependency and IaC scanning as enforced gates.
* **Test automation in CI:** 
 integrate automated testing into pipelines



  





**Nice to Have** 




  




* **Durable orchestration:** 
 Temporal preferred. Airflow, Step Functions or Argo Workflows transfer well.
* **IaC:** 
 Terraform and IaC pipeline integration.
* **Performance testing:** 
 k6, Gatling, JMeter or Locust. Any load\-testing background transfers well.
* **Ecosystem:** 
 Port.io or Backstage exposure, the Ocean framework or comparable connector frameworks, JQ for data mapping, and ServiceNow integration.
* **Security:** 
 Container and Kubernetes security.



  





**Technologies \& Tools** 




  





 The platform environment:
 



  




* **Developer portal:** 
 Port.io, or a Backstage background: catalogue, blueprints, self\-service actions and scorecards, with configuration\-as\-code in JSON and YAML. Custom integrations use the Ocean framework in Python, plus the Port API and Terraform provider.
* **Languages:** 
 TypeScript, Node.js and React, with Python for custom integrations and JQ for data mapping.
* **Orchestration:** 
 GitHub Actions, with Temporal for durable workflows.
* **Delivery toolchain:** 
 GitHub and Terraform, an IaC quality and security stack (Wiz, Checkov, OPA, tflint, Infracost, Terratest), and k6 performance testing running on Kubernetes.
* **Integrations:** 
 ServiceNow for approvals and CMDB, observability tooling, and enterprise identity and RBAC.

title: Tools Development Engineer
description:
We are seeking a qualified Software Tools Development Engineer to join our GPU SWQA team. The successful candidate will have strong experience applying AI technologies to automate test cases and a deep understanding of Windows operating systems. Extensive knowledge of GPU, CPU, SoC, x86, and ARM architectures is required, along with expertise in PC I/O architecture and common bus interfaces such as PCIe, USB, and SATA. Familiarity with specifications for general PC architecture components is a plus.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Design and implement automated tests incorporating AI technologies for NVIDIA's device driver software and SDKs on windows platforms.
* Build tools/utility/framework in Python, C\# or equivalent which would help automate and optimize the testing workflows in GPU domain. Develop and implement automated and manual tests, analyze results, identify and report defects.
* Rigorously drive test automation initiative. Build innovative ways to automate and expand our software testing.
* Expose defects and constraints; Isolate and debug the issue(s) and find the root cause; Contribute to the solution and drive to closure. Measure code coverage for the software under test, analyze and drive code coverage enhancements.
* Develop applications and tools that accelerate development and test workflows and write fast, effective, maintainable, reliable and well documented code. Generate and test compatibility across a range of products and interfaces and validate different key software applications across a test matrix designed to test both breadth and depth.
* Provide peer code reviews including feedback on performance, scalability and correctness.
* Report test coverage and Go/No\-Go status for deliverables, escalate critical issues, and drive them to closure.
* Participate in root cause analysis and corrective actions to continuously improve deliverable quality, workflows, and processes.
* Effectively estimate and prioritize tasks in order to create a realistic delivery schedule.
* You will have the opportunity to work on challenging technical and process issues and work closely with leadership to report progress, generating effective and actionable reports.
* This is a fully onsite position.


**What We Need To See**
* B.S / B.Tech/M.S in Computer Science / Electronics \& Telecommunication with strong academics or equivalent experience.
* 3\+ years of programming experience in Python, C\# or equivalent with experience in applying Object\-Oriented Programming concepts.
* Hands\-on experience developing Python scripts using application development concepts like dictionaries, tuples, RegEx, PIP etc.
* Working experience with databases and storage technologies like SQL, MongoDB and Elasticsearch.
* Experience working on Windows OS with a solid understanding of GPU, CPU, and SoC architectures.
* Experience using AI tools to automate test cases as well as end\-to\-end QA workflow.
* Strong communication skills, including effective interpersonal and cross\-team collaboration.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Highly organized, proactive, and quick to learn.
* Ability to work effectively with engineering teams in a fast\-paced environment.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Strong problem\-solving skills, including the ability to apply sound logic when isolating and regressing issues, along with strong written communication skills.
* Extensive experience with AI\-driven automation.
* Ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed team environment.
* Development experience fixing regression bugs and implementing or enabling tests for CI/CD pipelines.

 Comfortable assessing unfamiliar codebases and quickly identifying the highest\-impact quality improvements

title: Software Consultant
description:
**Department:** 
 Development
 



**Location:** 
 Pune, India
   

  




**Description**
**ParentPay Group** 
 is the largest EdTech company in Europe with over 1000 employees and more than £130m turnover. The group has a portfolio of software solutions for educational establishments which serve their management, payments, catering and library service needs.
   

 PPG is also the largest provider of school management software in the UK and touches the lives of over one million people every day, streamlining school administration and management to free up time for teaching and learning, with its market\-leading SIMS software solution
   

 SIMS is at the heart of 19,000 schools, including over 700 independent and international schools in 49 countries.
   

  

**What we are doing**
 We are developing a new single authentication solution that will be integrated and used by all products within the ParentPay Group.
   

 A new team will be forming and will be working under a DevSecOps culture using eXtreme Programming techniques, ensuring the highest standards of quality, security and delivery are met.
   

 The product will pass through a formal Service Transition process into live support, but the team should also have a firm focus on live service operations and where they fit into 3rd line support.
   

**Job Description**
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Consultant who is passionate about building products that deliver exceptional customer experience. You will contribute towards creating test scenarios, manual Testing, automating the scenarios and benchmarking the performance of products and services in the ParentPay group portfolio.
   

 You will be responsible for understanding the domain as well as technical intricacies of the product working on the product backlog, and aid in delivery acceleration through creative thinking, an evidence\-based approach and a keen focus on user and business value.
   

  

 The product will deliver a new Auth Solution for all group products, so alongside customer facing elements there will need to be a firm technical foundation. A solid understanding of technical principles and an ability to converse and work with solutions and technical requirements is therefore essential to success.
   

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 • Develop understanding of the Domain and technical intricacies of the product.
   

 • Consistently evaluate and become the expert in the domain space.
   

 • Collaborate with the product stakeholders to understand the Acceptance criteria thoroughly.
   

 • Build robust UI/UX solution using .NET, C\#, Microservices, HTML, CSS technologies.
   

 • Would need to work on Azure B2C implementation.
   

 • Strong understanding of architectural principles
   

 • Understanding of oauth api call sequence
   

 • Strong Agile Development Practices
   

 • Ability to work in a technical environment. Should have experience with Whitebox testing techniques.
   

 • Demonstrate clarity of thought and the ability to translate the complex into simple and consistent terms.
   

  

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
 Essential Skills
 * .NET 8 or later
* Azure ecosystem (ADO)
* C\#
* Strong understanding of architectural principles
* Strong understanding of API Design
* Agile Development Practices


 Desired Skills
 * k8s
* kiuwan or similar for security testing
* JUnit or similar for unit testing

You will collaborate closely with Requirements Engineers, Developers and Application Managers in both Pune and Frankfurt to verify and secure the technology solutions that support Deutsche Bank's lending operations.
* The Lending Platforms team is a global unit responsible for the development, enhancement, and maintenance of Deutsche Bank's core lending systems. As a critical function within our Private Bank Technology division, we manage the lifecycle of loan products on the SAP CML (Consumer and Mortgage Loans) platform. Our team is strategically located in Frankfurt and Pune, fostering a collaborative, multinational environment to deliver robust and innovative solutions for our business partners.


**What We’ll Offer You**
 As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,
   

  

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education

* Test Execution: Execute manual and automated tests for SAP CML and integrated systems, covering all phases of testing including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Regression Testing.
* Defect Management: Identify, log, and track defects with precision. Collaborate with development teams to analyze root causes and ensure timely resolution and re\-testing.
* Domain Expertise: Apply your in\-depth knowledge of the mortgages business lifecycle (origination, servicing, closure) to create/manage realistic and effective test scenarios.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work in close partnership with a multi\-national team of Requirements Engineers, Developers and Application Managers across Pune and Frankfurt to ensure a shared understanding of requirements and quality standards.
* Reporting and Documentation: Contribute to providing clear, concise, and timely reporting on test progress, defect status, and overall quality to project stakeholders. Maintain comprehensive test documentation.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Mortgages Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of the end\-to\-end mortgage lending business process, from application and underwriting to servicing and securitization.
* Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed, multi\-national team environment across different time zones.
* Analytical Mindset: Analytical and problem\-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.

description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a highly motivated
 **Senior Production Support \& Enhancement Engineer** 
 to manage end\-to\-end application development, maintenance, and production support for Java/Oracle\-based enterprise systems. Tieto Banktech powers some of the Nordics’ most trusted banking systems with secure, reliable, and scalable solutions. Using automation, data, AI, and cloud, supported by hands\-on guidance, we help banks modernize their core, strengthen trust, and deliver greater impact across the banking experience.
   

  

 This role is primarily focused on
 **60% development and enhancement activities** 
 and
 **40% production support and maintenance** 
 , requiring a strong balance of technical expertise and functional understanding. The ideal candidate will ensure high system availability while contributing to new feature development, custom change requests, POCs, and continuous improvement initiatives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and enhance Java\-based enterprise applications and backend services.
* Implement new features, custom change requests (CRs), and technical enhancements aligned with business requirements.
* Develop and maintain REST APIs using Java (Spring/Spring Boot preferred).
* Write, optimize, and maintain SQL/PL\-SQL queries, stored procedures, and database objects in Oracle.
* Participate in solution design discussions, technical feasibility analysis, and Proof\-of\-Concept (POC) initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with Non\-Functional Requirements (NFRs) including performance, scalability, security, and reliability.
* Provide L2/L3 production support by monitoring applications, analyzing logs, and resolving incidents within SLA timelines.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for production issues and implement permanent fixes.
* Coordinate with business users during requirement clarification, UAT cycles, and issue resolution.
* Handle service requests, defect fixes, deployment support, and release activities.
* Collaborate with QA, infrastructure, and cross\-functional teams to ensure system stability and smooth operations.
* Maintain proper documentation for incidents, changes, enhancements, and deployment activities.
* Contribute to automation, scripting, and operational efficiency improvements where applicable.


**Required Technical Skills**
* Strong experience in Java (Core Java, Spring/Spring Boot)
* Solid hands\-on experience with Oracle Database (SQL, PL/SQL, performance tuning)
* Experience in REST API development and backend services
* Knowledge of enterprise application architecture
* Experience in application production support (incident management, RCA, SLA handling)
* Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments
* Experience with version control tools (Git) and build tools (Maven)
* Working knowledge of ticketing tools (JIRA, ServiceNow, etc.)


**We offer**
 We offer you professional growth, meaningful projects, open culture and an outstanding work\-life balance! We offer you an opportunity to create the future of a growing, fast\-developing and important sector. We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working. Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle where you need to unlearn and relearn every day as new possibilities emerge.
   

  

 Did we get you inspired?
   

  

 We look forward to your application! Interviews will be held continuously, so we encourage you to apply today! For more information or questions, please contact krishna.kumari@tieto.com
   

  

 Hope to hear from you soon!
   

  

 Location: Pune
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.
   

  

 Diversity, equity and inclusion \| Sustainability \| Tieto
   

  

**Stay Alert To Recruitment Scams**
* Tieto only communicates via @tieto.com email addresses.
* We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
* If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.
* For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud \| Tieto Blog

title: Tech Lead – Production Support & Application Development
description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.
   

  

 Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.
   

  

 Technical Lead – Production Support \& Application Development
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a hands\-on technical professional with 5\+ years of experience in production support and application development for enterprise applications.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be able to troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, contribute to application enhancements, and work closely with development, QA, support, product, and business teams.

* Develop, enhance, test, and maintain enterprise application features, services, and integrations.

* Support deployment, release validation, post\-release checks, and operational stability activities.
* Collaborate with development, QA, support, product, and business teams to ensure timely issue resolution and smooth delivery.
* Create and maintain troubleshooting guides, technical documentation, and knowledge articles.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in software development, production support, application support, or production engineering.
* Strong experience with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and backend application development.
* Good understanding of SQL, relational databases, query troubleshooting, and data validation.
* Working knowledge of frontend technologies such as Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and JSON.
* Experience troubleshooting application, API, database, integration, and infrastructure\-related issues.
* Exposure to Git, CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, Agile/DevOps practices, and release support.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS and basic understanding of containers or cloud\-hosted applications.


 Good\-to\-have Skills
   

  

* Experience with Salesforce integrations, CRM platforms, licensing, entitlement, order management, subscription, or customer\-facing business applications.
* Knowledge of GraphQL, microservices, messaging platforms, API management, Docker, Kubernetes, or Azure Kubernetes Service.
* Exposure to monitoring and observability tools such as Azure Application Insights, Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, or similar platforms.


 Candidate Profile
   

  

 The candidate should be a practical, hands\-on engineer with strong debugging skills, an ownership mindset, and the ability to balance production stability with development delivery. They should communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders and be willing to learn new tools, technologies, and business processes.
   

  

 Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting\-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.
   

  

 If you share our passion for problem\-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?
   

  

 We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here."

title: Sr. Product Specialist(T)
description:
**Job Summary**
 This hybrid role is for a Sr Product Specialist T with four to eight years of experience in Manufacturing Execution System environments focusing on MES validation and manual testing activities within OpCenter Execution Pharma. The candidate will ensure robust product quality compliant delivery and reliable system performance that supports safe and efficient manufacturing operations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Execute comprehensive manual test cycles for OpCenter Execution Pharma solutions to verify end to end functionality performance and data integrity in real world manufacturing execution scenarios.
* Design detailed test cases and reusable test data sets for MES Val activities in order to validate system behavior against regulatory guidelines and internal quality standards.
* Coordinate closely with product owners and business stakeholders to clarify manufacturing execution requirements and translate them into clear test objectives and acceptance criteria.
* Analyze test results and document defects with clear reproducible steps so development and configuration teams can efficiently diagnose root causes and apply corrective changes.
* Review functional and technical design documents for Manufacturing Execution System features to identify potential quality risks and propose targeted test coverage improvements.
* Perform regression testing after configuration updates and patch deployments to confirm that existing MES workflows remain stable and that critical production processes are not disrupted.
* Collaborate with implementation consultants to validate integrations between OpCenter Execution Pharma and upstream or downstream systems such as laboratory data sources or enterprise resource planning platforms.
* Prepare structured validation reports for MES Val activities that summarize testing scope defect trends and quality risks to support audit ready documentation.
* Monitor day to day test progress in hybrid work settings and communicate clear status updates risks and mitigation actions to project teams and quality partners.
* Support user acceptance testing by guiding operational teams through test scenarios capturing feedback and refining test assets based on real usage patterns.
* Apply domain knowledge in Manufacturing Execution System processes to anticipate edge cases such as batch exceptions equipment downtime or material substitutions and incorporate them into test scenarios.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by refining test templates checklists and playbooks that enhance repeatability across future OpCenter Execution Pharma projects.
* Ensure strict adherence to data integrity practices and regulated industry expectations so that validated MES environments can be confidently used for compliant pharmaceutical production.


**Qualifications**
* Display strong hands on experience in MES Val activities with a consistent history of delivering structured validation packages for complex Manufacturing Execution System solutions.
* Demonstrate deep practical expertise in manual testing techniques including boundary testing negative testing and workflow validation within OpCenter Execution Pharma environments.
* Exhibit solid understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes such as electronic batch recording material traceability and shop floor execution so that test coverage reflects real production risks.
* Show proven ability to interpret user requirements functional specifications and configuration documents and convert them into actionable test cases and traceability matrices.
* Apply working knowledge of industry regulations and guidelines relevant to pharmaceutical manufacturing systems to ensure that validation documentation aligns with compliance expectations.
* Utilize effective communication skills in hybrid work settings to collaborate with cross functional partners across quality engineering operations and product teams without relying on travel.
* Employ analytical skills and attention to detail to prioritize defects by business impact and to support data driven decisions on release readiness for MES deployments.

title: Principal  Engineer
description:
****Who is Litmus****
 Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
   

  

 AI doesn’t work without real\-world, contextualized data \- Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
   

  

 We’re a growth\-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real\-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
   

  

 Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software\-defined manufacturing.
   

  

****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
 AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real\-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
   

  

****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
 Most AI systems fail without access to real\-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real\-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non\-negotiable.
   

  

****Have real impact, fast****
 You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
   

  

****Join a high\-performance team****
 We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
   

  

****Our culture****
 At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
   

  

 We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
   

  

**Principal Engineer** 
**About the Role**
 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Principal Engineer** 
 to lead the Pune engineering team for
 **Litmus Edge Manager (LEM)** 
 —our centralized platform for managing edge deployments across global manufacturing sites.
   

  

 You will provide technical leadership while actively contributing to product development, architecture, and engineering excellence. This role combines software engineering, team leadership, product collaboration, and quality ownership to build a high\-performing engineering organization.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead and mentor the Pune engineering and QA teams.
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Java and Go.
* Drive architecture decisions, code quality, security, and engineering best practices.
* Collaborate with global engineering and product teams to deliver product roadmap initiatives.
* Translate product requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Own engineering quality, testing strategy, and CI/CD standards.
* Build and grow the engineering team through hiring, coaching, and technical mentorship.
* Champion modern engineering practices, including AI\-assisted software development.


**Must Have**
* 12\+ years of software engineering experience with 5\+ years in a technical leadership role.
* Strong expertise in Java (Spring Boot) and good working knowledge of Go.
* Experience building distributed systems and microservices.
* Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, messaging systems, databases, and system design.
* Experience leading engineering teams and mentoring developers.
* Familiarity with CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and security best practices.
* Excellent communication skills and experience working with globally distributed teams.
* Experience using AI\-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with Industrial IoT, edge computing, or manufacturing software.
* Knowledge of MQTT, OPC\-UA, Modbus, Kafka, or RabbitMQ.
* Experience with AI/ML deployment at the edge.
* Familiarity with Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and observability platforms.
* Experience building Global Capability Centers or leading distributed engineering teams.


**Why Join Litmus?**
* Build next\-generation Industrial AI and Edge Computing products.
* Work on large\-scale distributed systems used by global manufacturers.
* Collaborate with highly experienced global engineering teams.
* Lead the growth of a strategic engineering team in Pune.
* Influence architecture, product direction, and engineering culture from day one.


 Litmus is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive workplace where innovation and collaboration thrive.

* Ensure adherence to security requirements, risk controls, regulatory obligations, and corporate governance standards.
* Participate in rotational production support and incident management activities.


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.


 Knowledge and Experience
   

  

* Advanced expertise in Oracle Exadata/RAC/Redis/PostgreSQL database engineering, administration, platform operations, and automation within large\-scale enterprise environments.
* Deep understanding of database architecture, resiliency, performance optimization, security, data governance, and operational best practices.
* Strong knowledge of platform engineering principles, including cloud infrastructure engineering, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Ansible, Chef or Puppet, CI/CD, and operational reliability.
* Experience supporting enterprise IT infrastructure and modern application platforms using automation at scale
* Understanding of distributed systems management and microservices\-based architectures.
* Experience establishing engineering standards, operational procedures, and platform governance practices.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction and contribute to technology strategy and platform modernization efforts.

* Proven ability to establish standards, implement best practices, and influence engineering outcomes.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

title: Senior Automation Tester / Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
**Company Profile: Quantum Integrators is an international strategy and business consulting group whose mission is to help clients create and sustain competitive advantage. As a truly client\-focused firm, our highly trained and experienced consultants consider it their mandate to help client organizations achieve a quantum state.** 




  





**Position : Senior Automation Tester / Senior QA Automation Engineer** 




**Location: Pune/Nagpur, Maharashtra (Onsite)** 




**Duration: Full time** 




**Shift: UK Shift** 




  





**Job Description:**



* We are looking for an experienced Senior Automation Tester with strong expertise in Python, Robot Framework, and Selenium Library to develop, maintain, and enhance automated test solutions for web\-based applications.
* The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of automation framework design, test planning, execution, defect management, and Agile methodologies. The candidate will work closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and QA teams to ensure high\-quality software releases.








**Technical Environment:**



* **IDE: PyCharm 2023\.3\.1**
* **Programming Language: Python 3\.12\.1**
* **Automation Framework: Robot Framework**
* **Web Automation Library: Selenium Library**
* **Source Code Repository: Bitbucket**



  





**Core Technology Stack:**




**Python 3\.12\.1 \| Robot Framework \| Selenium Library \| Selenium \| PyCharm 2023\.3\.1 \| Bitbucket \| Git** 









**Key Responsibilities:**



* Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using Robot Framework and Selenium Library.
* Develop reusable and maintainable automation components using Python.
* Analyze functional and technical requirements and create appropriate test scenarios and test cases.
* Build and enhance Robot Framework automation suites for functional, regression, integration, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Develop and maintain reusable keywords, libraries, test data, and automation utilities.
* Perform web application testing across supported browsers and environments.
* Identify suitable test cases for automation and maximize automation coverage.
* Execute automated regression suites and analyze test execution results.
* Troubleshoot automation failures and determine whether failures are caused by application defects, test scripts, test data, or environment issues.
* Log, track, and manage defects and work closely with development teams for resolution.
* Maintain automation source code and test assets in Bitbucket.
* Follow source\-control best practices, including branching, merging, pull requests, and code reviews.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Collaborate with developers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, and other QA engineers.
* Review existing automation frameworks and identify opportunities for improved reliability, maintainability, and execution speed.
* Create and maintain test documentation, automation standards, and execution reports.
* Mentor junior automation testers and provide guidance on Robot Framework, Python, SeleniumLibrary, and automation best practices.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes and automation strategy.



  





**Required Technical Skills**




**Python** 



* Strong hands\-on experience with Python for test automation.
* Good understanding of Python programming concepts, including:
* Functions and modules
* Classes and objects
* Exception handling
* Collections
* File handling
* Packages and libraries
* Ability to develop reusable Python utilities and automation libraries.



**Robot Framework** 



* Strong hands\-on experience with Robot Framework.
* Experience creating and maintaining Robot Framework test suites.
* Strong understanding of:
* Test cases and test suites
* User\-defined keywords
* Variables and variable files
* Resource files
* Tags
* Setup and teardown
* Test data management
* Test execution and reporting
* Experience integrating Python libraries with Robot Framework.
* Ability to develop scalable and maintainable Robot Framework automation frameworks.



**Selenium Library** 



* Strong experience with Selenium Library for web application automation.
* Experience working with:
* Locators
* Web elements
* XPath/CSS selectors
* Browser handling
* Wait mechanisms
* Windows and frames
* Alerts
* Dropdowns
* Dynamic web elements
* Experience troubleshooting Selenium synchronization and automation issues.



**Bitbucket / Source Control** 



* Hands\-on experience using Bitbucket for source code management.
* Good knowledge of Git commands and workflows.
* Experience with:
* Branching and merging
* Pull requests
* Code reviews
* Resolving merge conflicts
* Repository management
* Version control best practices



**Testing Skills:** 



* Strong understanding of SDLC and STLC.
* Experience in functional, regression, integration, system, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Strong understanding of test planning, test case design, execution, and defect lifecycle.
* Experience with defect management tools such as Jira or similar tools.
* Ability to perform root\-cause analysis of automation and application failures.
* Strong understanding of positive, negative, boundary, and data\-driven testing.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.



  





**Preferred Skills:** 



* Experience with API testing using Postman, REST APIs, or Python\-based API testing libraries.
* Knowledge of SQL/database validation.
* Experience integrating automated tests with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.
* Experience with parallel test execution and cross\-browser testing.
* Knowledge of Docker or cloud\-based test environments.
* Experience with BDD and Cucumber is a plus.
* Experience with performance testing is a plus.
* Familiarity with modern QA and continuous testing practices.



  





**Senior\-Level Expectations:** 




**The Senior Automation Tester is expected to:** 



* Take ownership of automation initiatives and deliverables.
* Design scalable and maintainable automation solutions.
* Identify gaps in existing automation coverage and recommend improvements.
* Conduct code reviews and enforce automation coding standards.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level QA engineers.
* Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders.
* Provide estimates and technical input for automation tasks.
* Investigate complex automation failures and provide root\-cause analysis.
* Continuously improve test execution efficiency and automation reliability.

title: Test Architect
description:
**Role:** 




 We're looking for a Test Architect to own our systems and integration testing strategy across complex, polyglot systems spanning C\+\+, Java and Python. Our test framework itself is written in Python, built on pytest, and we lean heavily on AI\-assisted development including Claude to build and extend it. You'll be the technical owner of that framework and the integration testing strategy behind it.
 



 This is a hands\-on architecture role, not a governance\-only position: you'll be writing Python/pytest day\-to\-day, building and evolving the framework, and working directly alongside engineers, while also acting as a client\-facing consultant understanding a stakeholder's technical challenges and driving the quality engineering roadmap that addresses them. Contract testing (e.g. Pact) is a useful tool in the kit, but it's a smaller part of the role than systems and integration testing
 



  





**Required Experience:** 



* 8\+ years as a Test Architect, Principal SDET, or senior test engineering leader, with proven ownership of systems/integration testing strategy for complex, distributed, polyglot systems.
* Strong hands\-on Python development with deep pytest expertise — building and maintaining test automation frameworks, not just writing test cases.
* Track record testing across service and process boundaries in polyglot environments spanning C\+\+, Java, and Python.
* Comfortable reading, and ideally writing, C\+\+ and Java alongside Python.
* Experience embedding automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, plus client\-facing consulting experience influencing senior stakeholders and shaping a test strategy roadmap.
* Open to work from Pune or Bengaluru location



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the systems and integration testing strategy across polyglot components (C\+\+, Java, Python), architecting suites that validate behaviour across service and process boundaries.
* Design, build and maintain the test automation framework in Python/pytest the backbone of how we test using AI\-assisted development tools (including Claude) to accelerate framework development and maintenance.
* Embed systems and integration tests into CI/CD pipelines, so breaking changes are caught before they reach production.
* Apply contract testing (e.g. Pact) selectively where it adds real value, as a complement to not a replacement for — the systems/integration test strategy.
* Partner directly with client engineering leaders to diagnose quality gaps, and propose and drive adoption of the tools, frameworks and practices that close them.
* Mentor and upskill engineers on Python/pytest test engineering and integration testing best practice, raising the quality bar across the wider team.
* Define and evolve the test automation roadmap for the engagement, balancing coverage, speed and maintainability.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* Proven experience as a Test Architect, Principal SDET or similar, having designed and led systems/integration testing strategy for complex, distributed, polyglot systems.
* Strong, hands\-on Python skills with deep pytest expertise this is the language and framework the test suite is built on.
* A track record of testing across service and process boundaries in polyglot environments.
* Comfortable reading (and ideally writing) C\+\+ and Java, since the systems under test span both alongside Python.
* Enthusiasm for using AI coding assistants such as Claude to build and maintain test tooling and frameworks.
* Some exposure to contract testing (e.g. Pact) is a nice to have, and not the focus of the role.
* Experience embedding automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Confidence operating as a client\-facing consultant: comfortable influencing senior technical stakeholders and shaping strategy, not just executing against a backlog.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate testing strategy into business outcomes for both engineers and clients.
